School of Artificial Intelligence, Beihang University

ru.title: Выравнивание супервизии для точного распределения кредита в обучении с подкреплением
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод AlignOPSD для обучения с подкреплением, который решает проблему рассогласования между временем принятия решения учителем и ученику при использовании плотной привилегированной обратной связи. Основная идея заключается в выравнивании супервизии перед назначением кредита: сначала переоценивают ответы ученика в функционально согласованных контекстах, затем применяют иерархическое назначение кредита на основе полумарковских процессов для правильного распределения награды. Метод был протестирован на моделях Qwen2.5 различных размеров на задачах ALFWorld, WebShop и Search-QA, показывая улучшения на 5.5-8.7% по сравнению с базовыми методами GRPO и StepOPSD. Предложенный подход более точно связывает обратную связь от учителя с действиями ученика, учитывая что решения могут охватывать несколько временных шагов.

en.title: Aligning Supervision for Better Reinforcement Learning
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenges in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, particularly the issue of sparse outcome rewards that can lead to misalignment in decision-making. The authors introduce AlignOPSD, a method that aligns supervision with the decision-making process of agents to improve learning efficiency. By implementing Decision-Aligned Supervision Rectification and Semi-Markov Hierarchical Credit Assignment, the approach ensures that feedback is contextually and temporally appropriate. The results show that AlignOPSD significantly outperforms existing methods, demonstrating its effectiveness in various tasks.

zh.title: 对齐监督，提升强化学习效果
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的强化学习方法，称为AlignOPSD，旨在解决决策时间戳不匹配的问题。传统的强化学习依赖稀疏的结果奖励，而AlignOPSD通过引入密集的特权反馈来增强学习信号。该方法通过对齐监督信息，确保学生的决策与教师的指导在时间上保持一致，从而提高了奖励分配的准确性。实验结果表明，AlignOPSD在多个基准测试中表现优于现有方法，显著提升了学习效果。

papers.title: When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety
papers.abstract: Abstract  Reliable AI safeguards require both control mechanisms that reduce unsafe behavior and monitoring mechanisms that detect safety risks during model interactions. Established behavioral safeguards include alignment methods that optimize model outputs and text monitors that assess interaction text. Representation engineering instead reads or modifies internal model states, but the relative strengths of these approaches remain unclear because they are often evaluated under different settings. We present a matched evaluation across two tracks. For safety control, we compare DPO, a behavioral alignment method, with three representation steering methods across robustness, practicality, and granularity. DPO provides the strongest overall control and generally improves with increasing training data, although its safety can degrade after subsequent benign fine-tuning. Representation steering remains competitive primarily in low-data settings, particularly with high-quality contrastive data. For safety monitoring, we compare representation probes with fine-tuned and open-weight text monitors across full-response detection, early detection, and computational cost. Specialized text monitors achieve the strongest overall detection accuracy, while representation probes remain competitive at substantially lower marginal cost. Finally, monitor-guided interventions recover much of the safety lost by DPO after benign fine-tuning, with little additional over-refusal. Overall, representation engineering does not generally replace behavioral safeguards, but offers practical advantages under specific conditions and can provide complementary safety benefits.
affiliations: School of Computer Science, Peking University
State Key Laboratory of Multimedia Information Processing, Peking University

ru.title: Синергия поведенческих и представленческих подходов к безопасности AI
ru.desc: В этой работе авторы проводят систематическое сравнение различных подходов к обеспечению безопасности больших языковых моделей. Они сопоставляют поведенческие методы выравнивания (например, DPO) с методами инженерии представлений, которые работают с внутренними состояниями модели. Для задачи мониторинга безопасности исследуются специализированные текстовые мониторы и зондовые методы на основе представлений. Результаты показывают, что оба подхода имеют свои преимущества: поведенческие методы обеспечивают лучший контроль в целом, а инженерия представлений остаётся конкурентоспособной при низких объёмах данных и меньших вычислительных затратах.

en.title: Balancing AI Safety: Control vs. Monitoring
en.desc: This paper discusses the importance of reliable AI safety mechanisms, focusing on both control and monitoring methods. It compares behavioral alignment methods, like DPO, with representation engineering techniques to evaluate their effectiveness in ensuring safe AI behavior. The findings indicate that DPO generally offers superior control, especially with more training data, but its safety can decline after further fine-tuning. In contrast, representation engineering shows competitive performance in low-data scenarios and can complement existing safety measures without fully replacing them.

zh.title: 安全保障：行为与表示的结合
zh.desc: 本论文探讨了可靠的人工智能安全保障机制，包括减少不安全行为的控制机制和在模型交互中检测安全风险的监测机制。我们比较了行为对齐方法DPO与三种表示引导方法在安全控制方面的表现，发现DPO在整体控制上最强，但在后续的良性微调后安全性可能下降。对于安全监测，我们比较了表示探针与微调和开放权重的文本监测器，结果显示专门的文本监测器在检测准确性上表现最佳。总体而言，表示工程在特定条件下提供了实用优势，但并不完全取代行为安全保障。

papers.title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
papers.abstract: Abstract  World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM{Codes and data} will be released.
affiliations: Key Laboratory of Water Big Data Technology of Ministry of Water Resources

ru.title: Предсказание будущих состояний для эффективной навигации летающих роботов
ru.desc: Статья представляет DroneWAM — эффективную модель world-action для визуальной навигации дронов, которая предсказывает, как действия будут влиять на будущие наблюдения. Модель использует архитектуру на основе JEPA и избегает дорогостоящей генерации будущих изображений путем работы непосредственно в пространстве представлений, а Resampler дополнительно сжимает признаки в меньшее количество скрытых токенов. Авторы вводят адаптивный rollout, где обученная на предпочтениях гейт динамически выбирает глубину предсказания в зависимости от сцены. Для обучения модели создан новый датасет DroneNav-6D с RGB-наблюдениями, 6-градусной свободой движения и симуляциями ветра.

en.title: Efficient Visual Navigation for Drones with Adaptive Prediction
en.desc: The paper introduces DroneWAM, a world-action model designed for efficient visual navigation in drones. It utilizes a JEPA-based architecture to predict future states directly in representation space, which eliminates the need for generating future images. The model incorporates a pretrained Resampler to compress dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, enhancing computational efficiency. Additionally, the adaptive rollout mechanism allows for dynamic prediction depth based on the scene, leading to improved trajectory accuracy and reduced computational load during navigation tasks.

zh.title: 高效无人机视觉导航的未来预测
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一种名为DroneWAM的高效世界-动作模型，旨在提升无人机的视觉导航能力。该模型采用JEPA架构，直接在表示空间中建模未来状态，避免了显式生成未来图像的高成本。通过预训练的重采样器，DroneWAM将密集的编码特征压缩为更少的潜在标记，从而减少每个想象步骤的计算量。此外，论文还引入了自适应展开技术，根据当前场景动态调整预测深度，从而提高了轨迹准确性。

papers.title: Draft-KV: Learning Useful Latent Communication Between Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Latent communication passes internal states between language models instead of decoded text, but higher receiver accuracy does not show that the receiver used the message content. Across five method-dataset pairs, replacing each message with one from an unrelated question changes accuracy by at most 0.60 points, even when communication adds 15.44 points over the receiver alone. Thus the interface can supply the gain while making the sharer dispensable. Draft-KV instead sends the key-value states formed while the sharer drafts an answer to the current question. Linear projections place these states in a side memory read through a gated attention branch, and progressive training moves from message reconstruction to answer supervision under a guard on harm from mismatched messages. Both models remain frozen and the interface trains 1.05M parameters, 348x fewer than C2C. With a Qwen3-8B sharer, a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct receiver reaches 78.04% on MMLU-Redux, versus 37.45% alone and 36.40% with reassigned messages. At fixed interface size, scaling the sharer from 0.6B to 8B raises accuracy from 46.11% to 78.04%; communication also transfers to held-out tasks and can exceed both models when each holds different evidence.
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
University of Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Эффективная передача знаний между моделями через скрытые состояния
ru.desc: В статье исследуется скрытая коммуникация между языковыми моделями, при которой передаются внутренние состояния вместо декодированного текста. Авторы обнаруживают, что высокая точность приёмника не гарантирует использование содержимого сообщения, так как замена сообщения на несвязанное изменяет результаты минимально. Предложен метод Draft-KV, который передаёт ключ-значение состояния, сформированные при генерации ответа, используя линейные проекции и гейтированное внимание в побочной памяти. Метод требует обучения только 1.05М параметров интерфейса при замороженных моделях и достигает 78% точности на MMLU-Redux, что значительно превосходит базовую производительность приёмника.

en.title: Enhancing Language Model Communication with Key-Value States
en.desc: This paper explores a novel approach to latent communication between language models, where internal states are shared instead of decoded text. The findings reveal that the accuracy of the receiver does not significantly depend on the content of the messages, as replacing messages with unrelated questions only slightly affects performance. The proposed Draft-KV method utilizes key-value states during the answer drafting process, enhancing the receiver's performance while minimizing the sharer's role. The results demonstrate that a smaller, frozen receiver can achieve high accuracy through effective communication, even outperforming individual models when they possess different information.

zh.title: 潜在通信：提升模型性能的新方法
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了潜在通信在语言模型之间传递内部状态，而不是解码文本。研究发现，接收者的准确性提高并不一定意味着接收者使用了消息内容。通过替换消息，准确性变化不大，表明接口可以提供增益，而不依赖于共享者。论文提出了一种新的方法Draft-KV，通过发送关键值状态来提高模型的性能，同时保持模型的稳定性和参数的高效性。

papers.title: TokenCast: Forecasting Token Consumption During LLM Agent Execution
papers.abstract: Abstract  When a large language model (LLM) agent executes the same task, token consumption can vary by over an order of magnitude across runs. The agent chooses its next steps based on tool feedback and intermediate results, while the growing context steadily inflates the input size of every subsequent call. The total consumption of a task is therefore hard to predict before execution and the prediction must be revised as the run unfolds. In this paper, we propose TokenCast, which learns a composable cost representation for each execution segment, recording its own consumption and the context growth it introduces. Composing adjacent segments yields a cumulative estimate that captures the extra input cost incurred when context from earlier segments is re-read by every later call. As execution unfolds, newly observed evidence refreshes the forecast, requiring no additional LLM calls and incurring a mean cumulative prediction time of 32.8 ms per run on SWE-bench Verified. Across 4 task suites and 6 agent models, TokenCast's mean absolute error reduction against the strongest comparator averages 14.5% over 96 evaluated combinations. In offline budget-control replay, TokenCast uses 21.3% fewer tokens on average than a fixed-budget policy at matched trace completion. The code is available at https://github.com/DEFENSE-SEU/TokenCast.
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: Предсказание расхода токенов в агентах на основе больших языковых моделей
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод TokenCast для прогнозирования потребления токенов в больших языковых моделях при выполнении задач. Авторы заметили, что количество токенов может сильно варьироваться между запусками одной и той же задачи из-за растущего контекста. Подход основан на обучении композиционного представления стоимости для каждого сегмента выполнения, которое записывает собственное потребление и рост контекста. При развертывании выполнения новые наблюдения обновляют прогноз в реальном времени без дополнительных вызовов модели.

en.title: Optimizing Token Usage with TokenCast
en.desc: This paper introduces TokenCast, a method designed to improve the prediction of token consumption in large language model (LLM) tasks. It addresses the challenge of varying token usage across different runs by learning a cost representation for each segment of execution. TokenCast captures the cumulative input cost by considering the context growth introduced by previous segments, allowing for more accurate forecasts as the task progresses. The results show that TokenCast significantly reduces prediction errors and token usage compared to traditional fixed-budget policies.

zh.title: TokenCast：优化LLM令牌消耗的智能预测
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为TokenCast的方法，用于优化大型语言模型（LLM）在执行任务时的令牌消耗。TokenCast通过学习每个执行段的可组合成本表示，记录自身的消耗和引入的上下文增长，从而提高预测的准确性。随着执行的进行，TokenCast能够根据新观察到的证据更新预测，而无需额外的LLM调用。实验结果表明，TokenCast在多个任务和模型上显著减少了令牌的使用，提升了执行效率。

papers.title: KVCMAS: Efficient KV cache Correction for Shared Context in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Abstract  Prompt-specialized multi-agent systems enable multiple agents to share a model while performing complementary roles to solve complex tasks. However, agent-specific prefixes change the KV cache generated for the same shared context, causing each agent to repeatedly prefill the growing context and construct a separate cache with high computation and memory overhead. Selective recomputation reduces this redundancy but still retains substantial model execution, while existing delta correction methods either support only recurring context relations or maintain memory-intensive online correction states for dynamically changing context. For first seen shared context, these methods also construct a reference cache outside the agent workflow, and an approximate correction at the first agent affects the outputs passed to subsequent agents. We present KVCMAS, an online KV cache correction framework that represents cross-agent cache deviations using compact low-rank states and seamlessly chains corrections along the agent workflow without an additional reference prefill. This design supports dynamically changing shared context while preserving an exact first-agent cache. Across multiple language and vision-language workloads, KVCMAS matches or improves the accuracy of prior KV cache sharing methods while achieving the lowest TTFT under highly concurrent serving. Under controlled serving traces, it provides a 2.0x TTFT speedup over inference without KV cache sharing and reduces peak GPU memory by up to 3.7x relative to a prior KV cache correction method. These results establish KVCMAS as an accurate and scalable KV cache sharing approach for prompt-specialized multi-agent serving.
affiliations: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University

ru.title: Общий KV cache для многоагентных систем с минимальными вычислениями
ru.desc: Статья представляет KVCMAS - фреймворк для оптимизации KV cache в многоагентных системах, использующих одну модель с разными промптами. Основная проблема заключается в том, что агент-специфичные префиксы создают разные KV cache для одного контекста, требуя повторного вычисления и увеличивая затраты памяти. Предложенный подход использует компактные низкоранговые представления для коррекции отклонений cache между агентами, избегая необходимости создания дополнительного эталонного cache. Метод обеспечивает 2x ускорение времени до первого токена и снижение памяти на 3.7x при сохранении точности работы.

en.title: KVCMAS: Efficient Cache Sharing for Multi-Agent Systems
en.desc: The paper introduces KVCMAS, a framework designed to improve the efficiency of key-value (KV) cache sharing in multi-agent systems that work on complex tasks. It addresses the issue of high computation and memory overhead caused by agent-specific prefixes that lead to redundant cache generation. KVCMAS utilizes compact low-rank states to represent cache deviations, allowing for seamless corrections along the agent workflow without needing a separate reference cache. The framework demonstrates significant improvements in accuracy and speed, achieving a 2.0x speedup in time-to-first-token (TTFT) and reducing peak GPU memory usage compared to previous methods.

zh.title: KVCMAS：高效的多智能体KV缓存共享框架
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为KVCMAS的在线KV缓存校正框架，旨在提高多智能体系统中共享模型的效率。该框架通过使用紧凑的低秩状态来表示跨智能体的缓存偏差，避免了额外的参考预填充，从而减少了计算和内存开销。KVCMAS能够支持动态变化的共享上下文，并保持第一个智能体的缓存准确性。实验结果表明，KVCMAS在多个语言和视觉语言任务中，准确性与之前的KV缓存共享方法相当或更好，同时在高并发服务下实现了最低的TTFT。

papers.title: PReCache: Efficient KV Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents via Low-Rank Precomputation and Neutral Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Abstract  Multi-LoRA agent systems enable efficient role specialization by sharing a common backbone model. However, each agent repeatedly processes the growing shared trajectory and constructs its own KV cache, introducing substantial memory and computation redundancy in long-horizon tasks. Existing KV cache sharing methods reduce this repeated prefill, but they either require additional training or architectural constraints or retain substantial model computation. Moreover, direct cache reuse causes the current agent to rely on cache states generated by the previous agent's adapter, weakening the role-specific behavior encoded by its own LoRA. We present PReCache, a training-free KV cache sharing framework with two designs, namely PreLRShared and ReBaseShared, that share the base cache computed using the pretrained weights and precompute a compact agent-specific low-rank (LR) cache. To remove repeated prefill, PreLRShared precomputes each agent's LR cache when the shared context is first processed, allowing the current agent to use its own LR cache without reprocessing context processed by previous agents. To improve sharing accuracy, ReBaseShared reconstructs the shared base cache from adapter-free hidden states, reducing the remaining error caused by the previous agent's adapted representation. To minimize its reconstruction cost, we propose two inference schemes tailored to single-stream inference and concurrent serving, performing the same reconstruction after each agent's turn or alongside its execution, respectively. Across multiple models and agent benchmarks, PreLRShared achieves up to a 3.1x TTFT speedup and a 2.3x improvement in per-request throughput over inference without KV cache sharing. ReBaseShared best preserves accuracy overall among the evaluated cache-sharing methods, with an average drop of only 1.1 points relative to inference without cache sharing.
affiliations: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Seoul National University

ru.title: Быстрое кэширование для мультиагентных систем без переобучения
ru.desc: В работе представлена система PReCache для эффективного совместного использования KV кэша в мультиагентных системах на основе LoRA. Основная проблема заключается в том, что каждый агент повторно обрабатывает растущую историю взаимодействия и создает собственный кэш ключ-значение, что приводит к избыточному использованию памяти и вычислений. Авторы предлагают два подхода: PreLRShared предвычисляет компактный низкоранговый кэш для каждого агента, избегая повторной обработки контекста, а ReBaseShared реконструирует базовый кэш из состояний без адаптера, чтобы сохранить специфичность роли каждого агента. Метод достигает ускорения в 3.1 раза при первом срабатывании и улучшает пропускную способность на 2.3 раза без значительной потери точности.

en.title: Efficient Cache Sharing for Multi-LoRA Agents
en.desc: The paper introduces PReCache, a framework designed to enhance the efficiency of Multi-LoRA agent systems by optimizing the sharing of key-value (KV) caches. It addresses the issues of memory and computation redundancy that arise when agents repeatedly process shared trajectories. PReCache features two main components: PreLRShared, which allows agents to use their own low-rank caches without reprocessing previous context, and ReBaseShared, which improves the accuracy of shared caches by reconstructing them from adapter-free hidden states. The proposed methods significantly speed up inference and maintain high accuracy, demonstrating their effectiveness in reducing computational overhead in long-horizon tasks.

zh.title: 高效的KV缓存共享框架PReCache
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为PReCache的KV缓存共享框架，旨在提高多LoRA代理系统的效率。该框架通过两个设计，PreLRShared和ReBaseShared，来减少内存和计算冗余。PreLRShared在首次处理共享上下文时预计算每个代理的低秩缓存，从而避免重复处理，而ReBaseShared则通过无适配器的隐藏状态重建共享基础缓存，以提高共享的准确性。实验结果表明，PReCache在多个模型和代理基准测试中显著提升了推理速度和请求吞吐量，同时保持了较高的准确性。

papers.title: ColNanoVDR: Document-Free Query Distillation for Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrieval via Optimal Transport
papers.abstract: Abstract  Multi-vector retrievers built on vision-language models lead visual document retrieval (VDR), but they run a multi-billion-parameter query encoder on every search. Distilling this encoder into a small student that queries the teacher's existing index would remove the bottleneck. The standard recipe, however, matches the teacher's MaxSim scores and so requires encoding and caching every training page, which can reach terabytes of page tokens. NanoVDR avoids pages entirely by training on the teacher's query embeddings alone, but only for single-vector retrievers. We present ColNanoVDR, to our knowledge the first framework to bring this document-free distillation to multi-vector VDR. Its objective, OTW (Optimal Transport with Learned Weights), aligns the student's query tokens with the teacher's by entropic optimal transport, with a learned weight for each student token, and needs no correspondence between the two tokenizations. We prove that the resulting alignment cost bounds the MaxSim score difference on every page. Distilled from five state-of-the-art teachers, the 149M text-only students retain about 95% of their teachers' NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1-v3 while encoding queries up to 26x faster. Under identical training, OTW matches score distillation while encoding no page and reading 12.6x less cached teacher data.

ru.title: Быстрый поиск документов без хранения больших данных
ru.desc: Статья описывает ColNanoVDR — новый метод дистилляции для мультивекторных систем поиска визуальных документов, построенных на моделях зрения и языка. Вместо традиционного подхода, который требует кодирования и кэширования всех страниц обучающего набора, предложенный метод обучается только на эмбеддингах запросов учителя, избегая необходимости работать со страницами. Ключевая инновация — объективная функция OTW (оптимальный транспорт с обученными весами), которая выравнивает токены запроса студента с токенами учителя через энтропийный оптимальный транспорт. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что студенты размером 149M параметров сохраняют около 95% качества больших моделей-учителей при 26-кратном ускорении кодирования запросов.

en.title: Efficient Document Retrieval with ColNanoVDR
en.desc: This paper introduces ColNanoVDR, a novel framework for visual document retrieval (VDR) that enhances efficiency by distilling a large query encoder into a smaller student model. Unlike traditional methods that require extensive caching of training pages, ColNanoVDR operates without needing to encode or store these pages, focusing solely on the teacher's query embeddings. The framework employs an Optimal Transport with Learned Weights (OTW) objective to align the student's query tokens with those of the teacher, ensuring effective learning without direct correspondence between tokenizations. As a result, the distilled student models achieve comparable performance to their larger counterparts while significantly reducing query encoding time and data storage requirements.

zh.title: 高效的多向量视觉文档检索框架
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为ColNanoVDR的新框架，旨在提高多向量视觉文档检索（VDR）的效率。通过将教师模型的查询嵌入直接用于训练，而不需要处理大量页面数据，ColNanoVDR显著减少了计算资源的消耗。该框架采用了最优传输（OTW）方法，能够在不需要对应关系的情况下，将学生的查询令牌与教师的令牌进行对齐。实验结果表明，经过这种蒸馏的学生模型在保留教师模型性能的同时，查询编码速度提高了26倍。

papers.title: EvolvingAvatar: Interactive 3D Head Generation That Adapts as Conversations Unfold
papers.abstract: Abstract  Interactive 3D head generation requires coordinated speaking and listening motion that responds to an evolving conversation. Existing generators use incoming observations as context but keep their parameters fixed, leaving conversational patterns unused as a learning signal. We introduce EvolvingAvatar, a causal generator that uses test-time training to adapt to user face video and dyadic audio during interaction. Its dyadic context prediction objective provides a self-supervised learning signal from audiovisual context without target motion labels at test time. Persistent fast weights accumulate these updates within each conversation to guide motion generation, while transient jaw adaptation responds to current audiovisual context. Predicted speech activity controls how persistent adaptation guides motion. We also introduce InterHead-Bench, a unified 455.95-hour benchmark built from single-view and dual-view conversation videos. Experiments show improved conversational motion statistics over strong baselines. On the hardest out-of-distribution split, generation improves as conversations unfold, reducing mismatch with recorded user-avatar expression statistics by up to 11.1% from the first interval.

ru.title: Адаптивный аватар, обучающийся во время разговора
ru.desc: В работе предлагается EvolvingAvatar — каузальный генератор трёхмерных голов, который адаптируется к видео лица пользователя и аудио диалога во время взаимодействия через обучение на тестовых данных. Модель использует задачу предсказания диадического контекста, которая создаёт самоконтролируемый сигнал обучения из аудиовизуального контекста без меток целевого движения во время тестирования. Постоянные быстрые веса накапливают обновления параметров внутри каждого диалога, направляя генерацию движений, а непостоянная адаптация челюсти реагирует на текущий контекст. Авторы создали InterHead-Bench — объединённый бенчмарк из 455,95 часов видео диалогов для оценки качества генерации выразительных движений аватара.

en.title: EvolvingAvatar: Real-Time Adaptation for Interactive 3D Head Generation
en.desc: The paper presents EvolvingAvatar, a novel approach for generating interactive 3D heads that can adapt their speaking and listening motions in real-time during conversations. Unlike traditional models that use fixed parameters, EvolvingAvatar employs test-time training to learn from user-specific face videos and audio inputs, enhancing its responsiveness. It utilizes a self-supervised learning signal derived from audiovisual context, allowing it to improve motion generation without needing labeled data. The method incorporates persistent fast weights for ongoing adaptation and transient adjustments for immediate audiovisual context, leading to significant improvements in conversational motion accuracy compared to existing models.

zh.title: 实时适应的互动3D头像生成
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一种名为EvolvingAvatar的互动3D头像生成方法，能够根据用户的面部视频和双向音频在对话中实时调整生成的动作。与传统方法不同，EvolvingAvatar在测试时进行训练，利用音视频上下文作为自监督学习信号，而无需目标动作标签。该方法通过持久的快速权重在每次对话中积累更新，指导动作生成，同时瞬时的下颌适应则响应当前的音视频上下文。实验结果表明，EvolvingAvatar在对话动作统计上优于强基线，并在最具挑战性的分布外测试中，随着对话的展开，生成的动作与用户-头像表达统计的差异减少了多达11.1%。

papers.title: Adaptive Consistency Graph for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  Large language model agents can often make reasonable local decisions on short tasks, yet their performance degrades when success requires long sequences of dependent actions and tool calls. During execution, task requirements, historical evidence, and the current execution state may gradually become disconnected, so later decisions can drift from the original objective. We study this problem by introducing the Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG) for long-horizon execution. ACG incrementally organizes execution evidence and its provenance in a persistent graph, then constructs a temporary requirement-centered view for each decision under a bounded context budget. Rather than replacing the base agent's planner or tool executor, ACG provides a structured and traceable context view for each decision. In the matched evaluation, ACG improves GPT-5.6-luna's average success from 44.5\% with ReAct to 50.2\%, with the largest gain on BrowseComp-Plus (73.5\% versus 62.4\%). We further analyze trajectory structure and inference cost to characterize this improvement.

ru.title: Граф консистентности для навигации агентов в долгосрочных задачах
ru.desc: В статье предложен метод Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG) для улучшения производительности агентов на основе больших языковых моделей при выполнении долгосрочных задач с множественными зависимыми действиями. Проблема заключается в том, что при длительной последовательности операций агент может отклониться от исходной цели, поскольку требования задачи, исторические данные и текущее состояние выполнения могут рассинхронизироваться. ACG решает эту проблему, организуя доказательства выполнения в графовой структуре и создавая временное представление, сфокусированное на требованиях задачи в рамках ограниченного контекстного бюджета. Экспериментальные результаты показывают улучшение успешности выполнения задач с 44.5% до 50.2% и особенно значительный прирост на сложных тестах до 73.5%.

en.title: Enhancing Long-Horizon Decision Making with Adaptive Consistency Graphs
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenges faced by large language model agents when performing long tasks that require a series of dependent actions. It introduces the Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG), which helps maintain a connection between task requirements and execution state by organizing evidence in a persistent graph. ACG enhances decision-making by providing a structured context for each action without replacing the existing planning or execution systems. The results show that ACG significantly improves the success rate of the model in complex tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing long-horizon execution.

zh.title: 自适应一致性图：提升长任务决策的有效性
zh.desc: 大型语言模型在短任务上能做出合理的局部决策，但在需要长序列依赖动作和工具调用的任务中表现较差。随着执行的进行，任务要求、历史证据和当前执行状态可能逐渐脱节，导致后续决策偏离原始目标。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了自适应一致性图（ACG），它在持久图中逐步组织执行证据及其来源，并为每个决策构建一个临时的以需求为中心的视图。ACG并不替代基础代理的规划器或工具执行器，而是为每个决策提供了一个结构化和可追溯的上下文视图，从而提高了模型的成功率。

papers.title: Geometry as Address: Routing Attention to Visual Memory for Long-Horizon Camera-Controlled Video Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation requires recovering previously observed content from an ever-growing visual history. Existing approaches either search historical context implicitly or reconstruct it into persistent 3D memory, facing inefficient memory access or accumulated geometric errors. Our key insight is that geometry need not explain the scene--it only needs to determine where visual memory should be read from, while attention decides what should be recovered. Based on this insight, we introduce GEAR, a Geometry-Enabled Attention Routing framework that uses geometry as an explicit token-level address for visual memory. Rather than fusing historical observations into a persistent global 3D representation, GEAR retains them as frame latents and uses per-frame geometry only to establish token-level correspondences with target views, thereby avoiding persistent error accumulation from global fusion. Guided by these correspondences, Geometric Correspondence Attention (GCA) selectively injects geometrically matched historical features into noisy target patches during denoising. We further introduce an Invisible Octree to accumulate visibility evidence and reject geometrically plausible but occluded correspondences. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GEAR achieves state-of-the-art visual quality, precise camera control, and revisit consistency, enabling minute-long video generation along challenging trajectories.
affiliations: State Key Laboratory of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University

ru.title: Геометрия как адресация памяти для управляемой генерации длинных видео
ru.desc: В статье предложена система GEAR для генерации видео с контролем камеры на длительных последовательностях, которая решает задачу восстановления ранее наблюдаемого контента из растущей визуальной истории. Ключевая идея заключается в использовании геометрии не для реконструкции трёхмерной сцены, а для определения адресов доступа к памяти признаков отдельных токенов, позволяя механизму внимания решать, какие элементы восстанавливать. Система хранит латентные представления кадров вместо глобальной трёхмерной модели и применяет Geometric Correspondence Attention для избирательного внедрения исторических признаков в целевые области при шумоподавлении. Дополнительно введена структура Invisible Octree для фильтрации геометрически правдоподобных, но закрытых соответствий, что позволяет достичь высокого качества, точного контроля камеры и генерировать видео длиной в минуты по сложным траекториям.

en.title: GEAR: Smart Geometry for Better Video Memory Retrieval
en.desc: This paper presents GEAR, a novel framework for long-horizon video generation that leverages geometry to enhance visual memory retrieval. Instead of creating a global 3D representation, GEAR uses frame-specific geometry to establish token-level correspondences, which helps avoid errors from global fusion. The framework employs Geometric Correspondence Attention (GCA) to selectively integrate relevant historical features into the current frame, improving denoising and visual quality. Additionally, an Invisible Octree is introduced to manage visibility and filter out occluded correspondences, resulting in superior camera control and consistency in generated videos.

zh.title: 几何引导的视觉记忆生成
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为GEAR的框架，用于长时间摄像机控制的视频生成。该框架利用几何信息作为视觉记忆的显式地址，而不是将历史观察融合成持久的3D表示，从而避免了全局融合带来的误差累积。GEAR通过几何对应注意力（GCA）选择性地将几何匹配的历史特征注入到目标图像中，提升了去噪效果。实验结果表明，GEAR在视觉质量、摄像机控制精度和重访一致性方面达到了最先进的水平。

papers.title: Pruned CTC for Memory-Efficient Large-Vocabulary ASR Training
papers.abstract: Abstract  Connectionist temporal classification (CTC) naturally supports offline and streaming speech recognition with utterance-level supervision, but conventional implementations materialize frame-by-vocabulary activations in memory, making CTC training with native LLM vocabularies prohibitively memory-intensive. A key observation is that every valid CTC alignment uses only target tokens and blank, and their union across a batch typically forms a small subset of the full vocabulary. We introduce Pruned CTC, which restricts alignment computation to this subset while retaining full-vocabulary normalization. We prove that this vocabulary reduction is exactly equivalent to full-vocabulary CTC in loss and gradients. Head-and-loss activation memory no longer scales linearly with vocabulary size. We further apply finite-beam alignment pruning. Building on Pruned CTC, we develop LLM-CTC, which adapts pretrained LLMs for non-autoregressive ASR while retaining causal attention and native vocabularies, and extend it to bounded-history streaming, avoiding chunk-level speech--text alignments. Experiments show that, with Zipformer-M encoder and 180K vocabulary, Pruned CTC reduces full-step memory by 5.1times with only 17% step-time overhead. Across three corpora, it matches standard CTC accuracy. On GigaSpeech, across six Qwen3 model sizes from 0.6B to 32B, LLM-CTC remains within 7% relative WER of LLM-CE with 7 to 10times faster recognition; when fine-tuning Qwen3-ASR for bounded-history streaming, LLM-CTC remains within 3% relative WER of matched offline models on the test set. Together, these results establish Pruned CTC as a scalable sequence objective for native-vocabulary LLM ASR across offline and streaming settings.

ru.title: Эффективное распознавание речи с большими словарями через прунинг CTC
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод Pruned CTC для эффективного обучения моделей распознавания речи с большими словарями. Основная идея заключается в том, что при выравнивании в CTC используется только небольшое подмножество всего словаря, поэтому авторы ограничивают вычисления этим подмножеством, сохраняя при этом полную нормализацию. Авторы доказывают математическую эквивалентность предложенного подхода стандартному CTC в терминах loss-функции и градиентов. На основе Pruned CTC они разработали LLM-CTC, который позволяет использовать предварительно обученные языковые модели для не-авторегрессивного распознавания речи с потоковой обработкой, достигая 5-7 кратного сокращения памяти при минимальных потерях в качестве.

en.title: Efficient Speech Recognition with Pruned CTC
en.desc: This paper presents Pruned CTC, a method that optimizes connectionist temporal classification (CTC) for speech recognition by reducing the vocabulary size during training. By focusing only on the relevant target tokens and blanks, it significantly decreases memory usage while maintaining the accuracy of full-vocabulary CTC. The authors also introduce LLM-CTC, which adapts large language models for non-autoregressive automatic speech recognition (ASR) without losing the benefits of causal attention. Experimental results demonstrate that Pruned CTC can reduce memory requirements by over five times while achieving comparable performance to standard CTC methods.

zh.title: 修剪CTC：高效的语音识别新方法
zh.desc: 连接时序分类（CTC）在离线和流式语音识别中具有自然的优势，但传统实现需要大量内存来存储词汇激活。我们提出了修剪CTC，通过限制对小词汇子集的对齐计算，显著减少了内存使用，同时保持了全词汇的归一化。实验表明，修剪CTC在内存使用上减少了5.1倍，并且在多个语料库上与标准CTC的准确性相匹配。基于修剪CTC，我们开发了LLM-CTC，使预训练的大语言模型适应非自回归的语音识别，且在流式处理中表现出色。

papers.title: AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors
papers.abstract: Abstract  When a VLM answers a visual query, current interpretability tools rely on text rationales, which use a mismatched modality, or on internal read-outs, which originate too early to reflect the final output and require white-box access to the model. We introduce AnswerMap, a training-free, task-agnostic, black-box visual rationale constructed from the output head. The image is cut into K row and K column bands, each shown alone to the frozen model along with the query in the format of a yes/no relevance question. The outer product of the row and column ``yes'' posteriors gives the query-conditioned spatial map. Crucially, by defining a fixed read-out R (e.g., expectation, maximum) on top of AnswerMap, we can derive continuous outputs like location natively. This bypasses the reliance on discrete text tokens for continuous-output tasks and guarantees an image-dependent answer by construction. However, a rationale can be confabulated, so we validate AnswerMap across four models and three query distributions with two tests: (a) agreement with the model's own generated point and (b) deletion of the map's region. The map lands where the model points (AUC 0.85 against 0.38 for attention), and deleting its region flips 53% of correct answers (against 19% for attention's). Beyond establishing faithfulness, we demonstrate the map's task-agnostic utility through three distinct read-outs: its maximum flags hallucinated objects without generation, its expectation localizes correctly when the model's own pointing fails, and its top-mass region, fed back as a crop, fixes half of the model's wrong answers. AnswerMap thus offers a new lens on VLM interpretability and, through its read-outs, a new output interface for visual tasks beyond text tokens.
affiliations: Department of Computer Science, Edge Hill University, Ormskirk, England
King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Thuwal, Saudi Arabia

ru.title: AnswerMap: визуальное объяснение решений моделей зрения без белого ящика
ru.desc: В работе предложен AnswerMap — метод интерпретируемости для визуальных моделей (VLM), который создает визуальные объяснения без доступа к внутренним слоям модели. Метод разбивает изображение на полосы по строкам и столбцам, тестирует каждую отдельно с помощью бинарных вопросов релевантности, а затем вычисляет пространственную карту через внешнее произведение вероятностей. Авторы показывают, что AnswerMap успешно выявляет области, на которые полагается модель (AUC 0.85), и могут применять различные операции над картой для решения разных задач: детектировать галлюцинации, локализовать объекты или исправлять ошибки модели. Данный подход является универсальным и не требует переобучения модели, обеспечивая лучшую интерпретируемость по сравнению с методами на основе внимания.

en.title: Visual Rationale Redefined: Introducing AnswerMap for VLM Interpretability
en.desc: This paper presents AnswerMap, a novel approach for interpreting visual language models (VLMs) by generating visual rationales directly from the model's output. Instead of relying on text-based explanations or early internal outputs, AnswerMap constructs a spatial map based on the model's responses to yes/no relevance questions about different sections of an image. The method allows for continuous outputs, such as location, by applying a fixed read-out on the generated map, which enhances the model's interpretability and performance on visual tasks. Validation shows that AnswerMap effectively aligns with the model's predictions and improves accuracy by identifying critical image regions, making it a versatile tool for understanding VLM behavior.

zh.title: AnswerMap：提升视觉语言模型可解释性的全新视角
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为AnswerMap的新方法，用于提高视觉语言模型（VLM）的可解释性。与传统方法依赖文本推理或内部读出不同，AnswerMap通过将图像切割成行和列的带状区域，结合查询生成空间映射。该方法不需要模型的白盒访问，且能够提供连续输出，如位置，避免了对离散文本标记的依赖。通过在四个模型和三种查询分布上进行验证，结果表明AnswerMap在模型指向的区域上具有较高的准确性，并能有效修正模型的错误答案。

papers.title: FactorEngram: Factorized N-gram Memory with Basis-Level Gating for Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Lookup-based memory has been a promising way to scale the parameters of large language models (LLMs). It retrieves learned representations of local token patterns, such as n-grams, instead of reconstructing them through successive layers of computation. However, existing designs such as Engram treat each retrieved embedding as a monolithic unit. Each embedding is stored in its own hashed slot and modulated by a single scalar gate. As a result, polysemous patterns cannot selectively read out the components of their memory that are relevant to the context. Moreover, parameters are shared only through hash collisions, which are largely unrelated to semantics. We propose FactorEngram, a factorized n-gram memory with basis-level contextual gating. FactorEngram retrieves sparsity-regularized coefficients over a dictionary of basis vectors shared across patterns, so related patterns can reuse common components. The same dictionary is also used for gating. The backbone hidden state is scored against each basis vector to gate the corresponding coefficient before reconstruction, which lets the context modulate each memory component individually. FactorEngram also covers both individual tokens and multi-token n-grams, and we systematically study where the memory branch should be inserted. On 340M- and 1B-parameter Transformer backbones, FactorEngram improves language modeling and downstream task performance. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component and identify insertion before the attention sublayer in the middle layers as an effective configuration.
affiliations: Large Model Frontier Research Department, Baidu Inc., China

ru.title: Факторизованная память n-грамм с контекстными воротами для эффективного масштабирования больших языковых моделей
ru.desc: В работе предлагается FactorEngram — улучшенная архитектура памяти на основе поиска для масштабирования LLM, которая использует факторизованное представление n-грамм паттернов через словарь общих базисных векторов. В отличие от существующих подходов, где каждое извлеченное представление обрабатывается монолитно, предложенный метод позволяет контексту модулировать каждый компонент памяти отдельно через контекстные ворота на уровне базиса. Система охватывает как отдельные токены, так и многотокенные n-граммы, и авторы систематически исследуют оптимальное размещение ветви памяти в архитектуре Transformer. Экспериментальные результаты показывают улучшение как в задаче языкового моделирования, так и в решении нижестоящих задач для моделей размером 340M и 1B параметров.

en.title: FactorEngram: Contextual Memory for Enhanced Language Modeling
en.desc: This paper introduces FactorEngram, a novel approach to enhance memory retrieval in large language models (LLMs) by using a factorized n-gram memory system. Unlike previous methods that treat embeddings as single units, FactorEngram allows for contextual gating, enabling the model to selectively access relevant components of memory based on the context. This method improves the efficiency of parameter sharing among similar patterns, addressing issues with polysemy and hash collisions. The results show that FactorEngram significantly boosts performance in language modeling and various downstream tasks when integrated into Transformer architectures.

zh.title: FactorEngram：提升语言模型的记忆能力
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种新的记忆机制，称为FactorEngram，用于大规模语言模型的参数扩展。与传统的Engram设计不同，FactorEngram通过共享基础向量的字典来实现稀疏性正则化，使得相关模式可以重用共同的记忆组件。该方法允许上下文对每个记忆组件进行单独调节，从而提高了多义模式的选择性读取能力。实验结果表明，FactorEngram在语言建模和下游任务性能上均有显著提升。

papers.title: DISCO: Distributed Long Context Scaling with Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation
papers.abstract: Abstract  While Large Language Models (LLMs) advertise million-token context windows, reasoning quality often collapses as inputs grow -- a phenomenon termed context rot. This failure stems from a structural entanglement in monolithic architectures, where the massive search burden of contextual grounding exhausts the representational capacity needed for complex reasoning. To resolve this, we propose Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation via DIStributed long COntext scaling (DISCO). Inspired by distributed computing frameworks like Apache Spark, DISCO partitions long context across a fleet of Worker LLMs dedicated exclusively to parallel, localized grounding. A central Driver LLM, trained via Reinforcement Learning (GRPO) to optimize planning, orchestrates execution by dynamically mapping queries into atomic extraction tasks and reducing the gathered evidence to synthesize a final answer. By isolating reasoning from raw context noise, DISCO effectively eliminates context rot. On RULER-QA (1M tokens), it maintains 78.4% accuracy where standard baselines collapse. Furthermore, it outperforms full-context models by up to 9.8 points on LongBench v2 and matches frontier models like Gemini-3-Pro-Preview while reducing inference costs by over 80%, establishing a highly efficient paradigm for robust long-context inference.

ru.title: Распределённая обработка длинного контекста через разделение рассуждения и обоснования
ru.desc: В статье описывается проблема деградации качества рассуждений больших языковых моделей при обработке длинных контекстов, известная как context rot. Авторы предлагают метод DISCO, который разделяет задачу обоснования и рассуждения, используя архитектуру, вдохновленную распределенными вычислениями: рабочие LLM параллельно обрабатывают локальные участки контекста, а центральный Driver LLM координирует процесс и синтезирует ответ. Driver LLM обучается с помощью методики GRPO для оптимизации планирования запросов и маршрутизации задач. Предложенный подход демонстрирует значительное улучшение производительности на тестах с миллионными токенами и снижает стоимость инференса более чем на 80% при сохранении качества конкурентных моделей.

en.title: DISCO: Revolutionizing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs
en.desc: This paper addresses the issue of 'context rot' in Large Language Models (LLMs), where reasoning quality deteriorates as input size increases. The authors introduce a new approach called DISCO, which stands for Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation via DIStributed long COntext scaling. DISCO utilizes a system of Worker LLMs to handle contextual grounding in parallel, while a central Driver LLM coordinates the reasoning process through Reinforcement Learning. This method not only improves accuracy on large datasets but also significantly reduces inference costs, providing a more efficient way to manage long-context reasoning.

zh.title: 解耦推理与上下文，提升长上下文推理效率
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为DISCO的模型，旨在解决大型语言模型在处理长上下文时的推理质量下降问题，这种现象被称为上下文衰退。DISCO通过将长上下文分散到多个专门的工作语言模型中，来实现推理与上下文的解耦，从而减轻了上下文的搜索负担。中心驱动模型通过强化学习优化计划，动态地将查询映射为原子提取任务，最终合成答案。实验结果表明，DISCO在长上下文推理中表现出色，准确率显著高于传统模型，同时降低了推理成本。

papers.title: G^2PTQ: Improving LLM Post-Training Quantization with Generalized Gradient Compensation
papers.abstract: Abstract  Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a practical approach to reducing the memory and computational footprint of large language models (LLMs) without retraining. GPTQ-based methods have become the de facto standard, yet they suffer from two complementary limitations. Methods with local, layer-wise objectives lack global supervision; while methods with global objectives fix their Hessian estimates at the start and ignore first-order gradients, so their guidance grows stale as quantization proceeds. This paper presents G^2PTQ, a unified PTQ framework with Generalized Gradient Compensation that integrates both first- and second-order information under a globally supervised, block-wise optimization objective. By refreshing gradient and Hessian estimates before quantizing each Transformer block, G^2PTQ avoids the staleness of prior global methods. Furthermore, to stabilize the exact first-order compensation, we introduce a trust-region scaling mechanism that dynamically bounds the gradient step to prevent exploding weight updates. Finally, we derive efficient implementations for block-wise Hessian approximation and exact gradient compensation. Experimental results on various model families and bit-widths demonstrate that G^2PTQ enables better alignment with the full-precision model, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/G2PTQ/G2PTQ.
affiliations: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Глобальная оптимизация квантования с обновляемыми градиентами и Гессианом
ru.desc: Статья представляет G^2PTQ — новую методологию постобучающего квантования для больших языковых моделей, которая объединяет информацию первого и второго порядка под глобальной оптимизацией. Основное преимущество заключается в том, что метод обновляет оценки градиентов и матрицы Гессе перед квантованием каждого блока Трансформера, избегая устаревания информации. Авторы вводят механизм доверительной области для стабилизации компенсации градиентов и предотвращения взрывного роста весов. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что G^2PTQ достигает лучшего соответствия с полноточностной моделью по сравнению с существующими методами.

en.title: G^2PTQ: Enhancing Post-Training Quantization with Dynamic Gradient Compensation
en.desc: This paper introduces G^2PTQ, a new framework for post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models (LLMs) that improves upon existing methods. It combines first-order and second-order optimization techniques to provide better global supervision during the quantization process. By updating gradient and Hessian estimates dynamically for each Transformer block, G^2PTQ addresses the limitations of previous methods that relied on stale information. The proposed approach not only stabilizes weight updates through a trust-region scaling mechanism but also shows superior performance in aligning quantized models with their full-precision counterparts across various configurations.

zh.title: G^2PTQ：提升后训练量化的全局优化框架
zh.desc: 后训练量化（PTQ）是一种在不重新训练的情况下减少大型语言模型（LLM）内存和计算需求的实用方法。现有的基于GPTQ的方法存在局限性，局部目标缺乏全局监督，而全局目标又忽视了一阶梯度。本文提出了G^2PTQ，一个统一的PTQ框架，通过广义梯度补偿整合了一阶和二阶信息，采用全局监督的块优化目标。实验结果表明，G^2PTQ在与全精度模型的对齐上表现优于现有的最先进基线。

papers.title: SMAT: Simple and Efficient Merge-Aware Training
papers.abstract: Abstract  Model merging integrates the capabilities of multiple experts without joint retraining, but standard expert training optimizes task loss alone and does not guarantee good performance after merging. Merge-aware training (MAT) aims to improve merged performance, but existing methods do not fully account for common merging operations and add training cost. We observe that, from an expert's perspective, common merging methods can be described by three operations: Scale reweights its own update, Mask removes selected coordinates, and Perturb adds updates from other experts. Based on this view, we introduce SMAT (Simple MAT), which jointly optimizes expert loss and expected loss at simulated merged parameters generated by sampling scaling coefficients, masks, and additive noise. We further introduce periodic scheduling, kernel fusion, and parameter storage switching to make SMAT efficient, with one forward and one backward pass per step. Across four language and vision-language backbones, SMAT improves the mean score across five merging methods by 1.07-2.16 points over the strongest baseline for each backbone, with less than 2% training-time overhead over standard fine-tuning.

ru.title: Учитываемое слияние: тренировка экспертов с предвидением операций объединения
ru.desc: В статье рассматривается проблема объединения нескольких экспертных моделей без совместного переобучения. Авторы предложили SMAT (Simple Merge-Aware Training) — метод, который оптимизирует потери экспертов с учётом ожидаемых потерь на параметрах объединённой модели, симулируя различные операции слияния. Ключевая идея заключается в том, что любое слияние экспертов можно описать тремя операциями: масштабирование, маскирование и добавление обновлений от других экспертов. Метод достигает значительного улучшения качества на несколько пунктов с минимальными вычислительными затратами.

en.title: Enhancing Model Merging with Simple Merge-Aware Training
en.desc: This paper discusses a method called SMAT (Simple Merge-Aware Training) that enhances the performance of merged machine learning models without requiring extensive retraining. Traditional expert training focuses solely on minimizing task loss, which can lead to suboptimal results when models are merged. SMAT introduces a framework that considers common merging operations—scaling, masking, and perturbing—allowing for better optimization of both individual expert losses and expected losses from merged parameters. The method is efficient, requiring only one forward and one backward pass per training step, and shows significant performance improvements across various language and vision-language models.

zh.title: 高效的模型合并训练方法
zh.desc: 模型合并可以整合多个专家的能力，而无需联合重训练，但标准的专家训练仅优化任务损失，无法保证合并后的良好性能。合并感知训练（MAT）旨在提高合并性能，但现有方法未能充分考虑常见的合并操作，并增加了训练成本。我们观察到，从专家的角度来看，常见的合并方法可以通过三种操作来描述：缩放重新加权自身更新、掩码移除选定坐标、扰动添加来自其他专家的更新。基于这一观点，我们提出了SMAT（简单MAT），它通过对模拟合并参数进行采样，联合优化专家损失和期望损失，从而提高合并性能。

papers.title: KernelZero: Co-Evolving Proposer and Coder for Continuously Improved GPU Kernel Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract  High-performance GPU kernels are essential to modern machine learning systems, yet automatically generating kernels that are both correct and efficient remains challenging. Existing LLM-based approaches face two major limitations: the scarcity of high-quality training data aligned with the model's current capabilities, and the inherent trade-off between kernel correctness and performance. To address these challenges, we propose KernelZero, a co-evolution framework that continuously improves GPU kernel generation through two specialized models: a Proposer that generates Torch modules from API sets and a Coder that translates them into CUDA or Triton kernels. KernelZero uses a frontier-driven module generation mechanism to continuously produce capability-aligned training modules based on the Coder's current weaknesses. It further introduces Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO), which optimizes performance only after correctness becomes sufficiently reliable. By alternating the optimization of the Proposer and Coder, KernelZero forms an automatic curriculum that enables targeted and training-efficient capability improvement. Empirically, KernelZero-7B surpasses Claude-4.5-Sonnet on CUDA and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Triton. On KernelBench Level 1 and 2, it achieves CUDA pass@1 scores of 75.8% and 69.6%, respectively, with pass@10 reaching 100% and 97%. On Triton, it achieves pass@1 scores of 77.2% and 72.5%, respectively.
