University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Совместная эволюция моделей для генерации корректных и эффективных GPU ядер
ru.desc: Статья описывает KernelZero, фреймворк для автоматической генерации высокопроизводительных GPU ядер с использованием двух специализированных моделей: Proposer, который генерирует модули на PyTorch, и Coder, который переводит их в CUDA или Triton код. Основная инновация заключается в механизме фронтира, который непрерывно создаёт обучающие данные, выровненные с текущими возможностями модели, адресуя проблему дефицита качественных тренировочных примеров. Авторы предлагают Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO) — метод усиленного обучения, который сначала приоритизирует корректность кода, а затем оптимизирует его производительность. KernelZero-7B демонстрирует превосходящие результаты по сравнению с Claude-4.5-Sonnet и DeepSeek-V4-Pro, достигая pass@1 75.8% для CUDA на уровне сложности 1.

en.title: KernelZero: Revolutionizing GPU Kernel Generation for Machine Learning
en.desc: This paper presents KernelZero, a framework designed to enhance the generation of GPU kernels for machine learning applications. It addresses the challenges of generating correct and efficient kernels by using two models: a Proposer that creates Torch modules and a Coder that converts them into CUDA or Triton code. The framework employs a frontier-driven approach to generate training modules that align with the Coder's weaknesses, ensuring continuous improvement. Additionally, it introduces a novel optimization strategy that prioritizes correctness before focusing on performance, leading to significant advancements in kernel generation capabilities.

zh.title: KernelZero：自动生成高效GPU内核的创新框架
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为KernelZero的框架，用于自动生成高性能的GPU内核，以支持现代机器学习系统。该框架通过两个专门的模型进行协同进化：一个生成Torch模块的Proposer和一个将其转换为CUDA或Triton内核的Coder。KernelZero采用前沿驱动的模块生成机制，持续生成与Coder当前弱点相匹配的训练模块，并引入了正确性意识的群体相对策略优化（CA-GRPO），在确保正确性后再优化性能。通过交替优化Proposer和Coder，KernelZero形成了一种自动化课程，能够有效提升能力。

papers.title: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multi-Turn Image Editing
papers.abstract: Abstract  Instruction-based image editing has achieved strong performance in single-turn settings, yet practical editing is often iterative, with each instruction applied to the output of the previous turn. We find that existing editing models degrade rapidly under recursive editing and attribute this failure to a train-test mismatch in the conditioning distribution: models are trained on clean source images but must repeatedly condition on their own imperfect outputs at inference time. To address this, we propose MT-OPSD, an on-policy self-distillation framework that trains the model on self-generated conditioning states with editing supervision from a clean-conditioned teacher, without requiring multi-turn annotations. We further introduce LME-Bench, a benchmark of 100 ten-turn editing sessions for evaluating long-horizon robustness. Experiments across three editing backbones show that MT-OPSD substantially improves long-horizon editing success and reduces multi-turn collapse while largely preserving single-turn editing quality.

ru.title: Преодоление деградации при итеративном редактировании через самодистилляцию
ru.desc: Статья рассматривает проблему итеративного редактирования изображений по текстовым инструкциям, где каждая новая операция применяется к результату предыдущей. Авторы выявили, что существующие модели быстро деградируют при множественных применениях из-за несоответствия между данными обучения (чистые исходные изображения) и данными инференса (несовершенные выходы модели). Для решения этой проблемы предложен метод MT-OPSD, использующий самодистилляцию on-policy, который обучает модель на самогенерируемых состояниях с помощью учителя, обученного на чистых данных, без необходимости в аннотациях для нескольких ходов. Авторы также создали бенчмарк LME-Bench для оценки устойчивости моделей при длительных последовательностях редактирования.

en.title: Enhancing Iterative Image Editing with Self-Distillation
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenges of iterative image editing using instruction-based models, which often struggle when applying multiple edits in succession. The authors identify that these models perform poorly because they are trained on clean images but must work with their own imperfect outputs during editing. To solve this issue, they introduce MT-OPSD, a self-distillation framework that allows models to learn from their own generated outputs while still being guided by a clean reference. Additionally, they present LME-Bench, a new benchmark for testing the effectiveness of long-horizon editing, demonstrating that their approach significantly enhances the quality of multi-turn edits without sacrificing single-turn performance.

zh.title: 提升图像编辑的长效性与鲁棒性
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种新的图像编辑方法，称为MT-OPSD，旨在解决现有模型在递归编辑中的性能下降问题。我们发现，现有模型在训练时使用的是干净的源图像，但在推理时却需要依赖自身不完美的输出，导致效果不佳。MT-OPSD通过自我蒸馏框架，利用来自干净教师模型的编辑监督，训练模型在自生成的条件状态上进行编辑，而无需多轮注释。我们还引入了LME-Bench，这是一个包含100个十轮编辑会话的基准，用于评估模型在长时间编辑中的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Why Deterministic PRM Guidance Underperforms in Discrete Diffusion Reasoning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) expose a denoised solution at every step, which makes process reward model (PRM) guidance look like a way to spend compute at test time. We show that once denoising, PRM scoring, and outcome reward model (ORM) scoring are charged in the same budget of forward passes, its deterministic form loses to a much simpler baseline. Our PRMs score intermediate denoising states and are trained on the correctness of the final answer. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B with 8 candidates per GSM8K problem, keeping the candidate with the highest PRM score at every scoring step reaches 65.18%, while independent sampling plus an ORM reranker trained for the task reaches 75.13%. The gap grows to 12.69 percentage points (pp) with 32 candidates, and is 9.85 pp on MATH and 12.16 pp on MBPP. We trace it to two separable failures. First, guidance prunes on a weak signal: on GSM8K, PRM ROC-AUC falls from 0.77 to 0.54 as the mask ratio rises, a decay that persists when states are relabeled with fresh rollouts, and pruning lowers the best accuracy reachable from the candidate pool from 81.05% for independent samples to 67.30%. Second, on GSM8K and MATH, the PRM is a poor final judge: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler at the same budget restores that ceiling to 77.89%, yet selecting with the PRM gives 65.48%, on par with deterministic guidance, while a PRM retrained on final states matches the ORM on identical candidates. MBPP separates the two: there the PRM reaches 65.47% when reranking finished programs, on par with the ORM, but 50.88% when it guides denoising. The results point to two targets for dLLM guidance: keep correct partial solutions alive through early denoising, and leave the final choice to a verifier trained on final states. We release the corpus of denoising states with outcome labels and evaluation toolkit for reproducible comparisons at matched compute.

ru.title: Простые верификаторы лучше промежуточных наград при генерации текста
ru.desc: В работе исследуются дискретные диффузионные языковые модели и показывается, что использование процесс-ориентированных моделей вознаграждения (PRM) для направления генерации на этапе тестирования неэффективно при одинаковом бюджете вычислений. Авторы демонстрируют, что PRM плохо справляются с двумя задачами: сначала они неточно оценивают частичные решения во время денойзинга (из-за деградации сигнала), а затем плохо выбирают финальный ответ среди кандидатов. Предлагается более простой подход с использованием исходных моделей вознаграждения (ORM), который значительно превосходит методы на основе PRM: например, на GSM8K с 32 кандидатами разница составляет 12.69 процентных пункта. Исследование указывает на два направления улучшения: сохранение корректных частичных решений на ранних этапах денойзинга и использование верификатора, обученного на финальных состояниях.

en.title: Enhancing dLLM Guidance: Focus on Partial Solutions and Final Verification
en.desc: This paper discusses the performance of discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) when using process reward models (PRMs) for guidance during the denoising process. It reveals that while PRMs can score intermediate states, they often underperform compared to simpler methods, especially as the number of candidates increases. The authors identify two main issues: PRMs struggle with weak signals during pruning and are not effective as final judges of correctness. They suggest improvements for dLLM guidance by maintaining viable partial solutions and utilizing a verifier trained on final outcomes.

zh.title: 优化去噪过程，提升模型选择准确性
zh.desc: 本文探讨了离散扩散语言模型（dLLMs）在每个步骤中提供去噪解决方案的特性。研究表明，当去噪、过程奖励模型（PRM）评分和结果奖励模型（ORM）评分在相同的前向传递预算中进行时，PRM的确定性形式不如一个更简单的基线。通过对中间去噪状态进行评分，PRM在最终答案的正确性上进行训练。结果显示，在多个候选者的情况下，PRM的表现不如独立采样加上为特定任务训练的ORM重排序器。

papers.title: SkillDRE: Dual-Stage Red-Team Evolution of Agent Skills via Pre-Execution and Runtime Feedback
papers.abstract: Abstract  Agent skills package instructions, executable code, and task-specific resources into reusable artifacts that agents can improve using execution feedback. The same mechanism also enables attackers to evolve malicious skills, making them more effective and less detectable. However, a candidate skill may pass pre-execution scanning yet fail to realize its target under runtime defenses, while a revision that repairs execution may introduce new scanner findings. We introduce SkillDRE, a fully automated framework for evolving complete malicious skill packages through a dual-stage feedback loop. Given a benign task and its associated skills, SkillDRE autonomously constructs and validates a task-conditioned malicious objective and a verifiable judge rule. It then holds both fixed while evolving the skill implementation, with preservation of legitimate task capability. SkillDRE combines scanner-guided evolution with runtime-guided refinement informed by execution outcomes observed under runtime defense. Each runtime-guided revision returns to the pre-execution stage for rescanning and further optimization before re-execution, forming a cross-stage closed loop. Evaluated on SkillsBench across four victim models, SkillDRE achieves an average attack success rate of 45.28%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 40.3%, while its final submitted skills receive no SkillScan findings and largely preserve benign-task performance. These results show that two-stage defense feedback can serve as a useful learning signal for adaptive red teaming and that evaluating either defense stage in isolation can miss the resulting attack capability. Codes is available at https://github.com/whfeLingYu/SkillDRE
affiliations: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications

ru.title: Двухэтапная эволюция: обход защит через замкнутый цикл обратной связи
ru.desc: В статье предложена система SkillDRE, которая автоматически совершенствует вредоносные навыки агентов через двухэтапный цикл обратной связи, комбинируя проверку на статический анализ с анализом поведения при выполнении. Система управляется целью, определяемой задачей, и правилом верификации, в то время как реализация навыка эволюционирует для обхода защит на обоих этапах. Авторы демонстрируют, что итеративная оптимизация между этапами предварительного сканирования и выполнения кода создает мощный сигнал обучения для адаптивного тестирования безопасности. Результаты показывают достижение 45.28% успешности атак, превосходя базовые методы на 40.3%, при этом сохраняя легитимную функциональность задачи.

en.title: Evolving Malicious Skills with Dual-Stage Feedback
en.desc: The paper presents SkillDRE, an automated framework designed to evolve malicious skill packages while maintaining their effectiveness against defenses. It utilizes a dual-stage feedback loop that combines pre-execution scanning and runtime evaluation to refine the skills. By preserving the legitimate capabilities of the tasks, SkillDRE can adapt and optimize malicious skills without being detected by scanners. The framework demonstrates a significant improvement in attack success rates, highlighting the importance of integrating both defense stages for effective adaptive red teaming.

zh.title: SkillDRE：进化恶意技能的双阶段反馈框架
zh.desc: 本文介绍了一种名为SkillDRE的自动化框架，用于通过双阶段反馈循环进化恶意技能包。SkillDRE能够在保持合法任务能力的同时，构建和验证恶意目标，并在运行时防御下进行技能实现的演化。该框架结合了扫描器引导的演化和运行时引导的优化，形成了一个跨阶段的闭环。实验结果表明，SkillDRE在攻击成功率上显著超过了现有基线，展示了双阶段防御反馈作为自适应红队学习信号的有效性。

papers.title: VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

ru.title: Геометрия встречает диффузию: маршрутизация 3D информации для синтеза новых видов
ru.desc: В статье представлена VGGT-Diff — модель диффузии для синтеза новых видов объекта по разреженному набору изображений. Авторы решают фундаментальный компромисс между методами реконструкции, которые хорошо сохраняют наблюдаемую геометрию но плохо синтезируют неизвестные области, и диффузионными методами с сильными генеративными приорами. Ключевой компонент — Visual Geometry Router (VGR), который маршрутизирует геометрические признаки в условия для видео-диффузионной модели, сохраняя информацию о видимой и скрытой геометрии. Дополнительная регуляризация Point-Track Residual Consistency стабилизирует предсказания по нескольким видам и улучшает качество синтеза при интерполяции и экстраполяции видов.

en.title: Bridging Geometry and Diffusion for Enhanced View Synthesis
en.desc: VGGT-Diff is a novel approach for generating new views from sparse input images using a multi-view diffusion model. It combines the strengths of reconstruction-based methods, which maintain geometric accuracy, with diffusion-based methods that excel in generating new content. The model utilizes a Visual Geometry Router (VGR) to align visual tokens with 3D points, ensuring that both front and back surfaces are considered during the synthesis process. Additionally, it employs Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) to enhance the stability of the generated views, resulting in improved performance across various viewing conditions.

zh.title: VGGT-Diff：新视图合成的几何路由扩散模型
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为VGGT-Diff的几何路由多视角扩散模型，用于稀疏视图的新视图合成。现有的新视图合成方法面临重建与生成之间的权衡，VGGT-Diff通过将视觉几何潜变量路由到预训练的视频扩散模型来解决这一问题。每个视觉标记与3D点和置信度相关联，并通过置信度感知的视觉几何路由器（VGR）转化为查询对齐的潜在条件，从而指导目标视图的去噪。实验结果表明，在不同视角难度下，该方法在插值和外推任务中表现出竞争力或最先进的性能。

papers.title: ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Abstract  How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.

ru.title: Оптимальный масштаб пересмотра: контроль глубины исправлений в агентах на основе LLM
ru.desc: В статье предлагается ControlScope — методология для оптимизации масштаба ревизий в workflows языковых моделей. Исследование сравнивает три стратегии: продолжение генерируемого кода, редактирование аргументов следующего вызова инструмента и полную замену незавершенного workflow. Авторы проводят комплексную оценку на задачах работы с файловой системой, ALFWorld и AppWorld, анализируя баланс между качеством исправлений и вычислительными затратами. Результаты показывают, что ограничение доступных репаров значительно влияет на выбор агента и финальный успех выполнения задач.

en.title: Optimizing Workflow Revisions in Language Model Agents
en.desc: This paper introduces ControlScope, a framework for evaluating how much a language model agent should revise its workflow when generating code. It compares three strategies: continuing with generated code, editing data arguments for the next tool call, and replacing the entire workflow from a previous execution state. The study assesses the effectiveness of these strategies across various tasks, including filesystem operations and simulated environments like ALFWorld and AppWorld. Results indicate that the choice of revision strategy significantly impacts task completion rates and efficiency, highlighting the importance of repair access in the decision-making process of language model agents.

zh.title: 优化语言模型代理的修订策略
zh.desc: 本文探讨了语言模型代理在运行工作流中应修订多少内容。ControlScope比较了继续生成代码、编辑下一个工具调用的数据参数和用相同公共执行状态替换未完成的工作流。研究表明，不同的修复权限可以将可用的修复与代理选择的操作分开。通过对多个任务的评估，结果显示不同修复策略在完成任务的效率上存在差异。

papers.title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Abstract  Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, making inference expensive. Training-free token pruning reduces this cost, but aggressive compression can sharply degrade performance, often attributed to irreversible loss of task-relevant visual information. We show that this explanation is incomplete. In a fixed-context Pass@K analysis, repeated sampling from the same pruned visual representation recovers many examples missed by greedy decoding, indicating that useful visual evidence can remain accessible but be used unreliably. We call this the representation-utilization gap. Motivated by this observation, we introduce SCOPD, a sparse-context on-policy self-distillation framework in which a student generates reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same on-policy prefixes. SCOPD requires no ground-truth responses, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. We further introduce SCOPD+, which uses a small visual-budget intervention to identify visually sensitive response positions and selectively distill them. At 10% visual-token retention, the Vanilla model retains 86.37% of its unpruned performance across 13 benchmarks. SCOPD raises this to 90.49%, while SCOPD+ further improves it to 92.43%. Across token budgets, benchmarks, and pruning operators, our results show that efficient reasoning depends not only on which visual information survives pruning, but also on how reliably the model learns to use it.

ru.title: Мост между информацией и её использованием: эффективная компрессия визуально-языковых моделей
ru.desc: В работе исследуется проблема дорогостоящего вывода больших визуально-языковых моделей, которые обрабатывают изображения и видео как длинные последовательности токенов. Авторы обнаружили, что агрессивное сжатие визуальных данных приводит к потере информации не только из-за удаления релевантных признаков, но и из-за неправильного использования оставшихся визуальных представлений — так называемого gap между представлением и его использованием. Для решения этой проблемы предложен метод SCOPD, использующий самодистилляцию с разреженным контекстом, где студент обучается на обрезанных визуальных токенах под руководством учителя с полным контекстом. Результаты показывают, что при 10% сохранении визуальных токенов SCOPD+ достигает 92.43% производительности оригинальной модели, демонстрируя, что эффективный вывод зависит не только от того, какая информация сохраняется, но и от того, насколько надежно модель её использует.

en.title: Bridging the Representation-Utilization Gap in Vision-Language Models
en.desc: This paper discusses the challenges of using vision-language models (VLMs) that process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, which can be computationally expensive. It introduces the concept of the 'representation-utilization gap', highlighting that even when visual tokens are pruned, useful information may still be present but not effectively utilized. The authors propose a new framework called SCOPD, which allows a student model to learn from pruned tokens under the guidance of a full-context teacher model, improving performance without needing additional resources. Their experiments show that this approach significantly enhances the model's ability to leverage visual information, achieving higher accuracy across various benchmarks with minimal token retention.

zh.title: 提升视觉信息利用效率的自我蒸馏方法
zh.desc: 本文探讨了视觉语言模型（VLMs）在处理图像和视频时的推理效率问题。通过训练前的标记剪枝可以降低推理成本，但过度压缩会导致性能下降，主要是因为任务相关的视觉信息丢失。我们提出了一个新的概念，即表示利用差距，表明有用的视觉证据可能仍然存在，但模型使用不可靠。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了SCOPD框架，通过稀疏上下文自我蒸馏来提高模型的推理能力。

papers.title: Distillation Defenses Easily Break After Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Abstract  Distillation attacks copy the reasoning capabilities of closed-source large language models, allowing bad actors to replicate state-of-the-art performance at low cost. Attackers systematically collect a large volume of frontier model reasoning traces and then train (i.e., "distill") their own models on these traces. Existing defenses against distillation attacks are typically evaluated immediately after distillation, implicitly assuming attackers do not train their models any further. In this paper, we argue that a more realistic threat model includes further training with reinforcement learning after distillation. A misspecified threat model can give a false sense of security -- some defenses that seem effective after distillation can be broken after subsequent reinforcement learning. Practically, reinforcement learning lowers the bar for a distillation attack to be effective. We show that simple attacks can steal reasoning capabilities from existing closed-source language models using data easily obtainable from current APIs, yielding reasoning improvements equivalent to more sophisticated attacks that extract the full hidden traces. Results indicate that any distillation defense that leaks sufficient information to reconstruct approximate reasoning traces is likely ineffective. We conclude by discussing broader implications and batch-level distillation defenses which could be more effective.
affiliations: ELLIS Institute Tubingen & MPI for Intelligent Systems

ru.title: Дистилляция закрытых моделей усиливается обучением с подкреплением
ru.desc: В статье изучаются атаки дистилляции, при которых злоумышленники копируют способности закрытых больших языковых моделей путём сбора большого количества примеров рассуждений и обучения собственных моделей на этих данных. Авторы показывают, что существующие защиты неадекватно оценивают угрозу, так как предполагают завершение атаки сразу после дистилляции, игнорируя возможность дальнейшего обучения с подкреплением. Исследование демонстрирует, что reinforcement learning значительно снижает сложность успешной дистилляции и позволяет украсть способности рассуждения используя легкодоступные данные из публичных API. Авторы делают вывод, что любая защита от дистилляции, утекающая достаточно информации для восстановления приблизительных трасс рассуждений, неэффективна.

en.title: Reinforcement Learning: A Game Changer for Distillation Attack Defenses
en.desc: This paper discusses distillation attacks, where attackers replicate the reasoning abilities of advanced language models by training their own models on collected reasoning traces. It highlights that current defenses are often tested only right after distillation, overlooking the potential for attackers to further train their models using reinforcement learning. The authors argue that this oversight can lead to a false sense of security, as some defenses may fail against models that have undergone additional training. The findings suggest that any defense leaking enough information to reconstruct reasoning traces is likely to be ineffective, prompting a need for improved batch-level distillation defenses.

zh.title: 蒸馏攻击：潜在威胁与防御挑战
zh.desc: 蒸馏攻击可以复制封闭源大型语言模型的推理能力，使恶意行为者以低成本复现最先进的性能。攻击者系统地收集大量前沿模型的推理轨迹，然后在这些轨迹上训练自己的模型。现有的蒸馏攻击防御通常在蒸馏后立即评估，假设攻击者不会进一步训练他们的模型。本文提出，考虑到蒸馏后使用强化学习进行进一步训练的威胁模型更为现实，且一些看似有效的防御在后续强化学习后可能会失效。

papers.title: Playing to Par: Reinforcement Learning for Provably Optimal Quadrilateral Block Decompositions
papers.abstract: Abstract  A quadrilateral block decomposition of a planar domain is judged by whether it is complete, whether its elements are well shaped, and how many of its vertices are irregular. The last has a provable floor: the discrete Gauss-Bonnet identity enforces a lower bound on the total vertex irregularity of any all-quadrilateral mesh of a given domain purely based on its topology and corner angles. We train a reinforcement learning agent to build decompositions that reach this bound, which we call par. It acts directly on the mesh's half-edge data structure through local edits, with a policy network whose convolutions follow the mesh's own connectivity, so it applies unchanged to domains larger than any seen in training. The reward targets the floor directly, and it is sparse: random play reaches it on no domain with more than eight sides. We overcome this exploration barrier via behaviour cloning on optimal meshes that are trivial to construct, walked backward into demonstrations, before training it with PPO. On 96 held-out domains the agent produces an all-quadrilateral mesh on every one, a usable one on 95.7 on average, and a provably optimal one on 90; Gmsh's strongest configuration at the same element count completes 51, is usable on 38 and optimal on none, and even at three to fourteen times the elements never produces a more regular mesh. On 64 domains twice the training size the agent completes all, is usable on 62, and keeps a median excess over par below one against Gmsh's 39 at the same element count.

ru.title: Обучение нейронной сети генерации оптимальных четырёхугольных сеток через подкрепление
ru.desc: В статье разработан алгоритм на основе обучения с подкреплением для декомпозиции плоских областей на четырёхугольные блоки оптимального качества. Авторы используют дискретный аналог теоремы Гаусса-Бонне для определения теоретического минимума нерегулярности вершин в сетке и обучают агента достигать этой границы через локальные изменения в полусёберной структуре меша. Для преодоления сложности исследования пространства действий применяется предварительное обучение путём имитации на оптимальных примерах, после чего используется метод PPO для финальной оптимизации. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что агент значительно превосходит существующие методы типа Gmsh, достигая доказуемо оптимальные сетки на большинстве тестовых областей и хорошо обобщаясь на домены, не встречавшиеся при обучении.

en.title: Optimizing Quadrilateral Meshes with Reinforcement Learning
en.desc: This paper presents a method for creating quadrilateral mesh decompositions of planar domains using reinforcement learning. The authors focus on optimizing the mesh's vertex irregularity, which is constrained by the discrete Gauss-Bonnet identity, establishing a lower bound for any all-quadrilateral mesh. A reinforcement learning agent is trained to make local edits to the mesh's half-edge data structure, utilizing a policy network that respects the mesh's connectivity. The results show that the agent consistently produces high-quality meshes, outperforming traditional methods in terms of usability and optimality across various domains.

zh.title: 强化学习优化四边形网格生成
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的算法，用于生成平面区域的四边形网格分解。该算法通过直接操作网格的半边数据结构，利用策略网络进行局部编辑，以达到顶点不规则性的下限。研究表明，随机生成的网格在八边形以上的区域无法达到该下限，而通过行为克隆和PPO训练的智能体在96个测试区域中成功生成了全四边形网格。与传统工具Gmsh相比，该智能体在相同元素数量下表现出更高的网格质量和可用性。

papers.title: What masking geometry works best for EEG foundation models?
papers.abstract: Abstract  EEG foundation models hold promise for scalable brain-signal decoding across clinical and cognitive neuroscience applications, yet their pre-training pipelines remain poorly understood. Among design choices, the masking strategy is particularly critical: it determines what the network must predict and from which context. Yet it has never been ablated in isolation, as each new model bundles a new masking strategy with a new backbone and objective. In this paper, we formalize the design choices for spatio-temporal masking strategies and train various models with a single pipeline under varying masking configurations across two SSL frameworks (MAE and JEPA). We then systematically evaluate the resulting 58 pre-trained models on the 12 datasets of OpenEEGBench under a linear probe. Both frameworks agree on an optimal masking configuration and on shared failure modes. Outside these, performance is robust: 11 MAE and 9 JEPA configurations are statistically indistinguishable from the best. We further identify a novel JEPA-specific failure mode, tagged bias-inflation collapse, invisible to standard detectors. With a well-chosen mask, our pipeline reaches REVE-level downstream performance at a fraction of REVE's pre-training compute.

SCCN, INC, SDSC University of California San Diego
Yneuro, University of California San Diego

ru.title: Маскирование как ключ к эффективному предобучению моделей ЭЭГ
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуется роль стратегии маскирования в foundation models для анализа сигналов ЭЭГ. Авторы систематически изучают различные конфигурации спatio-временного маскирования в двух фреймворках самообучения (MAE и JEPA) на едином pipeline'е. Результаты показывают, что оба фреймворка сходятся на оптимальной конфигурации маскирования, хотя большинство других конфигураций демонстрируют устойчивую производительность. Исследование выявляет новый режим отказа, специфичный для JEPA, и демонстрирует, что правильно подобранная маска позволяет достичь производительности уровня REVE с меньшими вычислительными затратами.

en.title: Unlocking EEG Insights with Optimal Masking Strategies
en.desc: This paper explores the design choices in pre-training EEG foundation models, focusing on the critical aspect of masking strategies. The authors systematically evaluate various spatio-temporal masking configurations using two self-supervised learning frameworks, MAE and JEPA, across multiple datasets. They find that both frameworks converge on an optimal masking strategy while also revealing a specific failure mode unique to JEPA. Ultimately, the study demonstrates that with the right masking approach, their method can achieve high performance with significantly less computational resources compared to existing models.

zh.title: 优化掩蔽策略，提升脑电图模型性能
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了脑电图（EEG）基础模型在临床和认知神经科学中的应用潜力，特别关注其预训练流程。研究中，作者分析了时空掩蔽策略的设计选择，强调了掩蔽策略对网络预测的重要性。通过在两个自监督学习框架下（MAE和JEPA）训练不同的模型，作者系统评估了58个预训练模型的表现。结果显示，最佳掩蔽配置在两个框架中一致，并且在性能上表现稳健，部分配置的表现与最佳配置无显著差异。

papers.title: Safe Error Correction for Language Models: Frozen-Base Adjustment with Capability Preservation
papers.abstract: Abstract  We study a practical question: can a small correction module fix errors in a frozen language model's outputs without degrading its base capabilities? We propose CRN v2, a lightweight logit-level correction module (~34M trainable parameters, 0.73% of the 4.65B text module) that sits atop a fully frozen Gemma 4 E2B model. The base model is never updated; only the correction module learns, via supervised fine-tuning followed by reference-free DPO on 83,400 error-correction pairs. On a 60-question domain exam (CEHRI: Certified Human-Robot Intelligence, covering facts, arithmetic, and implicit-goal reasoning), CRN v2 corrects 53.3% of base-model errors (reworded variant: 43.3%) while showing no degradation on tested capability benchmarks (MMLU/BoolQ N=200; car-wash N=8). A LoRA baseline at the matched CRN v1 budget (6.6M params, rank 19) achieves 83.3% correction but suffers 30-75% capability loss on the same benchmarks -- the correction-capability tradeoff. An ablation shows that the KL preservation term (lambda=0.1) is critical: lowering it to 0.01 degrades correction to 35.0%. A hidden-state injection variant at earlier layers (1.6M params, SFT-only) reaches 50.0%/55.8% but does not exceed logit correction; shallower injection (layer 4) drops to 30.0%/28.3%; multi-depth logit correction (~35M) reaches only 40%; and longer training (5,000 SFT + 2,000 DPO) stays at 53.3% -- none of the alternative configurations we tested exceeded the rank-128 logit result, consistent with a best-achieved result of ~53% rather than a floor. This is a study of a design principle (frozen base + logit correction + KL anchoring), not a claim of architectural novelty. All code, main-result weights, and evaluation scripts are released (deep variant as code only -- no trained deep checkpoints).

ru.title: Исправление ошибок замороженной модели через компактный модуль коррекции логитов
ru.desc: В работе исследуется возможность исправления ошибок замороженной языковой модели с помощью небольшого модуля коррекции на уровне логитов. Предложенный CRN v2 содержит всего 34M обучаемых параметров (0.73% от размера базовой модели Gemma 4) и обучается через supervised fine-tuning и reference-free DPO на наборе пар для исправления ошибок. Модуль достигает исправления 53.3% ошибок базовой модели без деградации её основных способностей, в то время как альтернативный подход с LoRA демонстрирует значительную потерю производительности на тестовых бенчмарках. Исследование подтверждает важность KL-регуляризации для сохранения баланса между исправлением ошибок и сохранением исходных возможностей модели.

en.title: Enhancing Language Models with Lightweight Correction Modules
en.desc: This paper investigates whether a small correction module can improve the outputs of a frozen language model without harming its original performance. The authors introduce CRN v2, a lightweight correction module that learns to fix errors in the outputs of the Gemma 4 E2B model using supervised fine-tuning and reference-free DPO. The results show that CRN v2 successfully corrects over 53% of errors while maintaining the model's capabilities on various benchmarks. The study emphasizes the importance of a design principle that combines a frozen base model with logit correction and KL preservation to achieve effective error correction without significant trade-offs in performance.

zh.title: 小修正，大提升：CRN v2的力量
zh.desc: 我们研究了一个实际问题：一个小的修正模块能否在不降低基础能力的情况下修复冻结语言模型的输出错误。我们提出了CRN v2，这是一个轻量级的logit级修正模块，具有约3400万个可训练参数，仅占4.65亿文本模块的0.73%。在一个60题的领域考试中，CRN v2能够修正基础模型53.3%的错误，同时在能力基准测试中没有表现出能力下降。我们的研究表明，冻结基础模型与logit修正相结合的设计原则是有效的。

papers.title: NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract  We present NanoForecast v0.5, a 6.5M-parameter forecaster that competes with models 31x its size (TimesFM, 200M parameters) after training pipeline fixes and no architecture change. Retraining the v0.3 architecture with corrected loss-scope handling, tensor shape alignment, and wider augmentation coverage cuts overall Mean Absolute Scaled Error by 43.8% under one fixed protocol (MASE 3.030 to 1.704) on the same data and compute budget. NanoForecast v0.5 beats TimesFM on all three ETT datasets (MASE 0.676/1.110/0.287 vs. 0.705/1.360/0.545) and on exchange rate (4.317 vs. 4.383); TimesFM keeps a clear lead on the high-cardinality electricity and traffic sets. Against PatchTST (15M+ parameters, official configuration), v0.5 wins all three ETT sets. Training takes about 12 hours on a single cloud GPU (NVIDIA T4, Google Colab) and inference needs no GPU (measurements in this paper are on an Apple M4 CPU). We release all code, pretrained checkpoints, and evaluation framework under Apache 2.0 at https://github.com/eulogik/NanoForecast

ru.title: Маленькая модель, большие результаты: оптимизация обучения вместо архитектуры
ru.desc: Представлена NanoForecast v0.5 — компактная нейросетевая модель прогнозирования временных рядов с 6.5 миллионами параметров, которая конкурирует с моделями в 31 раз большего размера благодаря исправлениям в процессе обучения. Исправления в обработке loss-функции, выравнивании тензоров и расширении аугментации данных привели к снижению ошибки MASE на 43.8% при том же бюджете вычислений. Модель превосходит TimesFM на большинстве тестовых наборов данных и обучается за 12 часов на одном GPU, а инференс работает даже на процессоре Apple M4 без использования GPU. Вся реализация, предобученные веса и фреймворк оценки открыты под лицензией Apache 2.0.

en.title: Compact Yet Powerful: NanoForecast v0.5 Redefines Forecasting Efficiency
en.desc: NanoForecast v0.5 is a compact forecasting model with 6.5 million parameters that achieves competitive performance against much larger models, such as TimesFM with 200 million parameters. By improving the training pipeline through better loss-scope handling and tensor shape alignment, the model significantly reduces the Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE) by 43.8%. It outperforms TimesFM on various datasets while maintaining a low computational cost, requiring only 12 hours of training on a single cloud GPU. The authors provide all necessary resources, including code and pretrained models, to facilitate further research and application.

zh.title: NanoForecast：小模型，大预测力
zh.desc: 我们介绍了NanoForecast v0.5，这是一个拥有650万个参数的预测模型，经过训练后能够与31倍于它的模型（TimesFM，2亿参数）竞争。通过修正损失范围处理、张量形状对齐和更广泛的数据增强覆盖，重新训练v0.3架构使得整体平均绝对缩放误差降低了43.8%。在所有三个ETT数据集上，NanoForecast v0.5的表现优于TimesFM，并且在汇率预测中也取得了更好的结果。训练过程大约需要12小时，而推理则不需要GPU，所有代码和预训练检查点都已在Apache 2.0下发布。

papers.title: Not All Objectives Are Born Equal: Priority-Constrained Descent for Hierarchical Multi-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract: Abstract  Deep learning problems rarely involve objectives that are equal in importance. A primary objective defines the goal, whilst secondary objectives, such as sparsity, compression, or robustness constrain the solution. While existing multi-objective methods have proven effective in practice, they have a clear symmetry problem and neglect the inherent objective hierarchy built into these objective spaces. We introduce Priority-Constrained Descent (PCD), a gradient-based optimization framework designed to explicitly exploit hierarchical objective structures. PCD preserves the direction of primary descent whilst allowing for the minimal distortion necessary to guarantee progress on secondary objectives, controlled by a single τin [0, 1] that dictates the strength of the distortion. The resulting formulation is invariant to objective scaling and admits exact closed-form solutions for problems with two and three objectives. We evaluate PCD within structured network compression settings, unstructured sparsity and low-rankness, and across a variety of synthetic experiments, showing Pareto dominance and better per-objective performance with secondary progress guarantees over existing methods, further exhibiting the interpretable trade-off that τ provides.
affiliations: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, American University of Sharjah
Senseable City Laboratory, Massachusetts Institute of Technology

ru.title: Иерархическая оптимизация с приоритизацией целей в глубоком обучении
ru.desc: В статье предлагается новый метод оптимизации Priority-Constrained Descent (PCD) для решения задач многоцелевого обучения с иерархической структурой целей. Метод основан на градиентном спуске и сохраняет направление основного градиента, позволяя минимальное искажение для достижения прогресса по вторичным целям. Параметр τ контролирует силу этого искажения и обеспечивает интерпретируемый компромисс между целями. Авторы демонстрируют, что PCD показывает превосходство по Парето и лучшую производительность по отдельным целям на задачах сжатия нейросетей, разреживания и низкоранговой факторизации.

en.title: Optimizing Hierarchical Objectives with Priority-Constrained Descent
en.desc: This paper presents a new optimization method called Priority-Constrained Descent (PCD) for deep learning problems with multiple objectives. PCD addresses the common issue of unequal importance among objectives by maintaining a clear hierarchy, allowing the primary objective to guide the optimization while minimally adjusting for secondary objectives. The method ensures that the optimization process is invariant to the scaling of objectives and provides exact solutions for problems with two or three objectives. Through various experiments, PCD demonstrates improved performance and interpretable trade-offs compared to existing multi-objective optimization methods.

zh.title: 优先约束下降：优化多目标的层次结构
zh.desc: 深度学习中的多目标优化问题通常涉及不同重要性的目标。主要目标定义了最终的目标，而次要目标如稀疏性、压缩性或鲁棒性则限制了解决方案。本文提出了一种名为优先约束下降（PCD）的优化框架，旨在明确利用目标之间的层次结构。PCD在保持主要目标下降方向的同时，允许进行最小的扭曲，以确保次要目标的进展，从而实现更好的多目标优化效果。

papers.title: When Privacy Moves ML-Mediated Decisions On Device: Information and Incentive Misalignment in Auctions
papers.abstract: Abstract  Moving ML-mediated decision making onto privacy-preserving clients decentralises the economic decision along with the inference. Shared budget constraints then depend on information that cannot be globally current, creating an information-structure failure that conventional pacing is not designed to solve. We study this information misalignment in an auction-logic-faithful on-device simulation with 36 campaigns and 50 devices. Accounting is in dimensionless integer score units; no currency semantics are claimed. Across 30 paired demand paths, proportional Even pacing overspends 17.77% after one tick of staleness and 1,669.31% after 50 ticks under the original 20-times budget pressure. The effect does not depend on that severe a budget: at two-times pressure, 50-tick overspend remains 106.95%. A visible-budget no-sale guard makes zero-lag compliance exact at this score-unit granularity, yet leaves 11.88% overspend at one tick because other devices' debits remain invisible. A declared bursty, heterogeneous-device sweep retains a strictly increasing mean lag curve. We derive a finite-window expected excess-debit bound under conditional charge caps and find positive paired slack in every bounded-value cell. A second, incentive misalignment arises when the ML/pacing score transformation is allowed to change payment units: 98.23% of rival auctions at one tick admit a profitable deviation. An executable implementation-level counterexample isolates the runner-up's multiplier in the winner's price. Critical-base-bid payment is per-auction DSIC conditional on current multipliers, but does not establish dynamic truthfulness and does not repair base-value ranking disagreement.

ru.title: Синхронизация бюджетных ограничений в децентрализованных аукционах с запаздыванием информации
ru.desc: Статья исследует проблемы децентрализованного машинного обучения для принятия решений в аукционах, когда информация между устройствами не синхронизирована. Авторы показывают, что классические алгоритмы пейсинга бюджета работают неправильно при наличии задержки информации, приводя к значительному превышению лимитов. Предложены решения на уровне архитектуры, такие как видимые бюджетные ограничения и конечные окна ожидания, однако они не полностью устраняют несогласованность стимулов. Кроме того, изучена манипуляция платежными единицами в трансформации ML-пейсинга, которая раскрывает дополнительные уязвимости в механизме аукциона.

en.title: Decentralized Decision-Making: Tackling Overspending in ML Auctions
en.desc: This paper explores the challenges of using machine learning (ML) for decision-making in decentralized environments where privacy is a concern. It highlights how shared budget constraints can lead to information misalignment, causing overspending in auction scenarios when using conventional pacing methods. The authors conducted simulations to demonstrate that even slight delays in information can significantly impact budget adherence, with overspending rates reaching as high as 1,669.31%. They also discuss the implications of incentive misalignment in auction settings, revealing that many auctions allow for profitable deviations due to the transformation of payment units based on ML scores.

zh.title: 隐私保护下的机器学习决策与信息不对称
zh.desc: 本文研究了在隐私保护的客户端上进行机器学习决策时，信息不对称对经济决策的影响。我们通过在设备上进行的模拟实验，发现传统的节奏控制方法无法有效解决信息结构失效的问题。实验结果显示，在预算压力下，设备之间的信息滞后会导致显著的超支现象。最后，我们提出了一种新的方法来处理预算合规性问题，但仍然存在一定的超支风险。

papers.title: How Reproducible Are Evaluation Conclusions? A Self-Audit of LLM-Inferred Prompt Structure
papers.abstract: Abstract  Evaluations of LLM systems routinely average over small prompt sets and report models as a ranked table. We ask how much confidence such a table deserves, using LLM-based prompt-structure inference as the case study: eight open model variants across five families and 8B to 675B parameters, caching disabled, 293 raw intermediate representations persisted. The measured phenomenon is unstable to begin with. Identical calls do not reliably recover identical structure, with mean node-set Jaccard from 0.39 to 0.96 and 72% of prompt-model cells never node-set-perfect. Auditing the evaluation weakens its conclusions further, and this is our main contribution. Under a joint cluster bootstrap over prompts, only the bottom of the ranking is firm: the two least reproducible models hold rank in 99% and 86% of replicates, the middle four in 27% to 48%, and the top two in 68% each, so the table identifies the worst model reliably but does not reliably identify the best. Two equally defensible rules for merging repeated campaigns change four of eight rows and move the study-wide headline by 7 percentage points. Checking the inferred structure against ground-truth annotations shows reproducibility cannot be read as accuracy. And four of the eight endpoints were withdrawn within ten weeks of measurement, so the study as specified can no longer be run. Small-sample LLM evaluations can therefore look far more definitive than their evidence supports. We recommend reporting rank stability, per-cell provenance, executed sensitivity comparisons, raw per-run outputs, and a measurement date alongside any ranking.

ru.title: Ранги LLM-моделей менее надёжны, чем кажется
ru.desc: В статье исследуется надёжность оценок систем на основе LLM, которые обычно усредняют результаты по небольшим наборам промптов и представляют модели в виде ранжированной таблицы. Авторы обнаружили, что задача инференции структуры промптов нестабильна: одни и те же запросы не всегда дают идентичные результаты, и большинство пар промпт-модель не достигают идеальной воспроизводимости. При анализе стабильности рангов через бутстрап только худшие модели занимают стабильные позиции, в то время как лучшие модели имеют низкую надёжность ранжирования. Исследование демонстрирует, что малые выборки в оценке LLM могут выглядеть намного более убедительно, чем это поддерживает реальное свидетельство.

en.title: Evaluating LLMs: Stability Over Certainty
en.desc: This paper examines the reliability of evaluations for large language models (LLMs) by analyzing prompt-structure inference across various model sizes. The authors find that the results are highly unstable, with significant variability in the structure recovered from identical prompts. Their main contribution is highlighting that while the worst-performing models can be consistently identified, the best-performing models are not reliably ranked. The study calls for more transparency in reporting evaluation metrics, including rank stability and raw outputs, to better reflect the true performance of LLMs.

zh.title: 评估大型语言模型的可靠性与透明度
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）评估的可靠性，特别是在小样本提示集上的表现。研究发现，模型的结构推断结果不稳定，相同的调用并不总能得到相同的结构。通过审计评估过程，作者指出排名表的结论并不可靠，尤其是在识别最佳模型方面。最后，论文建议在报告排名时，提供排名稳定性、每个单元的来源、敏感性比较和测量日期等信息，以提高评估的透明度和可信度。

papers.title: Training and Inference Dynamics of PLDR-LLMs: Row-Map Collapse, Renormalization, and Predictive Reduction
papers.abstract: Abstract  This monograph develops a unified account of training and inference in Power Law Decoder Representation language models (PLDR-LLMs). Exact finite work identities decompose changes in the absolute energy of the row-centered learned map into parameter contributions, signed interactions, and numerical observation defects. Positive affine blocking retains restarts at the row-constant face, while the augmented AdamW state supplies the complete dynamical description.   Predictive renormalization acts on the complete conditional training law for a single pass over distinct corpus target blocks, retaining optimizer memory, remaining data, schedule, and numerical policy. Autonomous reductions require closure; approximate reductions carry successor and emission errors. Finite-population covariance, matched physical clocks, matrix fluxes, and signed temporal energy connect row dynamics to model-wide observations. Absolute row collapse, relative row concentration, operator stabilization, and predictive accuracy are distinguished.   Experiments reveal observer and optimizer dependence, reject the tested autonomous row-state candidates, and support finite conditional prediction and state-specific operator reduction. Independent single-pass families exhibit moving finite fluctuation regions without establishing a thermodynamic critical class. Conditional symmetry, head limits, covariance flows, and readout error budgets specify assumptions needed to transfer scaling laws to inference. The theory separates exact identities, conditional dynamical claims, and finite empirical findings, with proofs, selected formal checks, and compact numerical evidence.
affiliations: Fromthesky Research Labs LLC, Oregon, USA

ru.title: Единая теория обучения и инференса через энергетическую динамику нейросетей
ru.desc: В работе разработана единая теория обучения и инференса для языковых моделей PLDR-LLMs на основе степенных законов. Авторы используют точные конечные тождества для разложения изменений энергии обученного отображения на вклады параметров, взаимодействия и численные погрешности. Предиктивная ренормализация применяется к условному закону обучения с сохранением памяти оптимизатора, расписания и численной политики. Теория различает точные тождества, условные динамические утверждения и конечные эмпирические результаты, с формальными доказательствами и численными подтверждениями.

en.title: Unifying Training and Inference in Power Law Language Models
en.desc: This paper presents a comprehensive framework for understanding how Power Law Decoder Representation language models (PLDR-LLMs) are trained and used for inference. It introduces methods to analyze the energy changes in the model's parameters and how these changes affect performance. The authors explore various techniques, including positive affine blocking and augmented AdamW optimization, to enhance the training process. Through experiments, they demonstrate the importance of observer and optimizer interactions, leading to insights on predictive accuracy and model behavior under different conditions.

zh.title: 统一训练与推理的理论探索
zh.desc: 本文探讨了功率法解码器表示语言模型（PLDR-LLMs）中训练和推理的统一理论。通过精确的有限工作标识，分析了学习映射中绝对能量变化的来源，包括参数贡献、符号交互和数值观察缺陷。实验结果表明观察者和优化器的依赖性，并支持有限条件预测和状态特定的操作简化。理论上区分了精确身份、条件动态声明和有限经验发现，并提供了相关的证明和数值证据。

papers.title: How Does "English (US)" Become the Default? Triangulating Structural Bias Towards American English Across the LLM Pipeline
papers.abstract: Abstract Large language models exhibit systematic bias toward American English over British English across pretraining data, tokenization, and generation stages, reflecting broader geopolitical and colonial influences on AI development.  Generated by Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly embedded in educational, professional, and public infrastructure, yet widely used platforms expose "English (US)" as a primary English setting despite the global diversity of English. We ask: How does "English (US)" become the default? We study this question as structural bias, examining how geopolitical histories of data curation, digital dominance, and linguistic standardization intersect with the LLM development pipeline. Using British English as a controlled reference, we construct a curated resource of 1,813 matched American English (AmE)--British English (BrE) variants and introduce DiAlign, a dynamic, training-free method for estimating regional alignment from distributional evidence. We triangulate the AmE preference across data exposure --> representation --> generation, jointly examining pretraining and post-training data, tokenizer behavior and provenance, model prediction cost, and generated language across developer countries, prompt conditions, domains and sources, linguistic categories, and registers. AmE is consistently favored across all six audited pretraining corpora and 21 post-training datasets, is generally represented more compactly by tokenizers, and receives lower prediction cost. It also remains the dominant generation default under neutral English prompting; British-English prompting shifts this preference toward BrE but does not consistently eliminate the AmE default. To our knowledge, this is the first rigorous pipeline-wide study of structural bias across major phases of LLM development. Our findings show that contemporary LLMs privilege AmE as the de facto norm, raising concerns about linguistic homogenization, epistemic injustice, and inequity in global AI deployment, while providing a rigorous basis for targeted component-level intervention.

ru.title: Американский английский как скрытый стандарт в больших языковых моделях
ru.desc: В этой работе исследуется системное смещение крупных языковых моделей в сторону американского английского языка на всех этапах разработки: предварительном обучении, токенизации и генерации. Авторы вводят метод DiAlign для измерения региональных предпочтений и анализируют более 1800 пар американских и британских вариантов английского. Они обнаруживают, что американский английский последовательно привилегирован во всех изученных корпусах данных, более компактно представлен токенайзерами и имеет более низкую вычислительную стоимость при предсказании. Исследование показывает, что это структурное смещение отражает геополитические и колониальные влияния на разработку AI и может привести к лингвистической унификации и несправедливости при глобальном развертывании языковых моделей.

en.title: Unpacking the American English Bias in Language Models
en.desc: This paper investigates the bias of large language models (LLMs) towards American English compared to British English, highlighting how this preference is influenced by historical and geopolitical factors. The authors introduce a method called DiAlign to analyze the alignment of American and British English in LLMs, revealing that American English is favored in data exposure, representation, and generation stages. They find that this bias persists even when prompting the model with British English, indicating a structural issue in LLM development. The study emphasizes the implications of this bias for linguistic diversity and fairness in AI applications globally.

zh.title: 大型语言模型中的美式英语偏见
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了大型语言模型（LLMs）在预训练、标记化和生成阶段对美式英语的系统性偏见，反映了人工智能发展中的地缘政治和殖民影响。研究发现，尽管英语在全球有多样性，许多平台仍将“英语（美国）”作为默认设置。作者构建了一个包含1813对美式英语和英式英语变体的资源，并提出了一种新的方法DiAlign，用于估计区域对齐。研究结果表明，LLMs在各个阶段都偏向美式英语，这引发了对语言同质化和全球人工智能部署不平等的担忧。

papers.title: AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies
papers.abstract: Abstract  Guard models support the safe deployment of language model agents, but fixed risk taxonomies limit their ability to accommodate requirements that vary across applications and tasks. Under user-defined policies, detecting violations requires interpreting both the applicable rules and the agent's behavior, since identical actions can receive different judgments under different policies. To support learning this capability, we introduce AdaptiveSafety, a dataset of 10,939 training examples and 1,000 test examples covering policies with 1--100 rules. The dataset combines trajectories from multiple sources with policy and behavioral counterfactuals, pairing each example with an explanation and the complete set of violated rules. These counterfactuals expose changes that alter compliance, while structural augmentations provide supervision for consistency under rule reordering and identifier remapping. Building on this supervision, we propose SafePO, a reinforcement learning algorithm for refining violation identification while balancing explanatory reasoning and final verdicts. SafePO uses structured rewards to assess prediction correctness, retains group-relative advantages at the response level, and employs a separately trained value model to modulate token weights within explanation and verdict regions. Separate normalization controls their relative contribution to training despite differences in length. Through supervised initialization followed by SafePO, we develop AdaGuard, a family of 0.6B, 4B, and 8B guard models that assess agent trajectories under policies supplied at inference time. Our 4B model achieves binary accuracies of 89.30\% on AdaptiveSafety and 71.82\% on DynaBench. The project repository is available at https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/AdaGuard

ru.title: Адаптивная безопасность агентов через обучение с пользовательскими политиками
ru.desc: В работе предложен датасет AdaptiveSafety для обучения guard-моделей, которые могут адаптивно оценивать безопасность действий агентов языковых моделей в соответствии с пользовательскими политиками безопасности. Датасет содержит примеры с политиками разной сложности (1-100 правил) и включает контрфактические примеры, объяснения и полный набор нарушенных правил. Авторы предложили алгоритм SafePO на основе усиленного обучения, который балансирует между точностью выявления нарушений и качеством объяснений, используя структурированные награды и отдельную модель ценности. Разработанное семейство моделей AdaGuard (0.6B, 4B, 8B параметров) достигает высокой точности в оценке траекторий агентов при произвольных политиках, поданных во время инференса.

en.title: Adaptive Safety for Language Model Agents
en.desc: The paper introduces AdaptiveSafety, a dataset designed to enhance the safety of language model agents by allowing them to adapt to various user-defined policies. It includes a large number of training and test examples that illustrate how different rules can lead to different judgments for the same actions. The authors propose SafePO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that improves the identification of policy violations while ensuring that explanations for these violations are clear and accurate. The resulting AdaGuard models are capable of evaluating agent behavior against dynamic policies, achieving high accuracy in identifying compliance violations.

zh.title: 自适应安全：提升语言模型的违规识别能力
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一种名为AdaptiveSafety的数据集，旨在支持语言模型代理的安全部署。该数据集包含10,939个训练示例和1,000个测试示例，涵盖了1到100条规则的用户定义政策。我们提出的SafePO是一种强化学习算法，用于改进违规识别，同时平衡解释推理和最终判决。通过监督初始化和SafePO，我们开发了AdaGuard系列守护模型，能够在推理时根据提供的政策评估代理的行为。

papers.title: Routing Drift Alone Does Not Diagnose Failure in Merged MoE LLMs
papers.abstract: Abstract  Model merging efficiently combines specialized large language models (LLMs) without joint retraining, but can substantially alter expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Such routing drift is often interpreted as routing failure, raising a fundamental question that remains unclear: does routing drift after MoE merging actually indicate routing failure, and what evidence should justify repair? We investigate these questions across DeepSeekMoE, OLMoE, and Qwen3-MoE proposing a routing analysis toolkit for controlled counterfactual interventions and token-level analysis. By crossing source and merged router inputs and parameters, we attribute most expert reassignments to input shifts rather than parameter changes at the same layer. However, source-relative routing differences poorly predict next-token likelihood gains from source-route restoration, and different expert selections can produce directionally similar mixture outputs. We therefore operationalize routing failure as task loss recoverable under a specified routing intervention, with non-routing parameters fixed. These tests detect recoverable loss under deliberate router corruption, whereas source-route restoration does not establish reliable task benefits in the evaluated merged models. Motivated by these, we propose Selective Router Repair (SRR) as a case study, and find that source-specialist token-likelihood advantages do not reliably identify beneficial local corrections. Together, these findings show that routing drift alone is insufficient evidence of routing failure: source-informed corrections must be judged by their task-level intervention effects. The analysis toolkit and SRR code are released.

ru.title: Дрейф маршрутизации при объединении моделей — не всегда признак отказа
ru.desc: Статья исследует проблему дрейфа маршрутизации, возникающей при объединении специализированных больших языковых моделей в архитектуре Mixture-of-Experts, и показывает, что изменение выбора экспертов не всегда указывает на отказ маршрутизации. Авторы разработали аналитический инструментарий для контрфактических вмешательств на уровне токенов, позволяющий выявить, что большинство переназначений экспертов вызваны сдвигом входных данных, а не изменением параметров. Они переопределили понятие отказа маршрутизации как восстанавливаемую потерю производительности при конкретных вмешательствах в маршрутизацию, и обнаружили, что восстановление исходной маршрутизации часто не приносит реальных преимуществ. На основе этих выводов предложен метод выборочного восстановления маршрутизатора, демонстрирующий, что исправления, основанные на исходной информации, должны оцениваться по фактическому влиянию на качество решения задач.

en.title: Understanding Routing Drift in Merged Language Models
en.desc: This paper explores the concept of model merging in large language models (LLMs), specifically focusing on how it affects expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The authors introduce a routing analysis toolkit to investigate whether changes in expert routing after merging indicate a failure in routing. Their findings suggest that most changes in expert assignments are due to shifts in input rather than changes in model parameters. They propose a new method called Selective Router Repair (SRR) to assess routing effectiveness, concluding that routing drift alone does not signify failure, and that corrections should be evaluated based on their impact on task performance.

zh.title: 路由漂移不等于路由失败
zh.desc: 模型合并可以高效地结合专门的大型语言模型（LLMs），而无需联合重训练，但这可能会显著改变混合专家（MoE）模型中的专家路由。路由漂移常被视为路由失败，这引发了一个基本问题：MoE合并后的路由漂移是否真的表明路由失败？我们通过对DeepSeekMoE、OLMoE和Qwen3-MoE的研究，提出了一种路由分析工具包，以进行控制的反事实干预和令牌级分析。我们的研究表明，大多数专家重新分配是由于输入变化，而不是同一层的参数变化，因此仅凭路由漂移不足以证明路由失败。

papers.title: PyroAdapt: Adapting Wildfire Prediction under Spatial Heterogeneity and Temporal Shift
papers.abstract: Abstract  Prediction of wildfire occurrence is a rare-event problem compounded by spatial heterogeneity and temporal distribution shift, as fire occurrences are vastly outnumbered by non-occurrences, and predictor--fire relationship varies across space and time. Models trained on historical fire data may perform poorly under new conditions and require adaptation to the target distribution before operational use. We propose PyroAdapt, a pretrain--retrieve--rank framework that adapts a pretrained model to target conditions by retrieving historical locations with similar conditions and fine-tuning on the retrievals through risk ranking. For spatial adaptation, we condition risk on terrain, ecoregion embeddings, and fire rates, accounting for spatial context in the retrieval, and learn risk ordering from same-day fire--nonfire cell pairs. We compare direct ranking, residual pairwise DPO (RDPO), and selective ranking through a unified score-gap formulation that characterizes their gradient allocation. Over California (discretized into 666 0.25x0.25 grid cells), these objectives raise daily average precision from 21.62% for continued focal fine-tuning to 24.35--24.57%, and Top5% recall from 18.70% to 22.11--22.79%. Under a fixed daily detection budget of 34 cells (5% area), selective ranking captures 344 additional positive cell--days. For fires in the top 5%/10%/20% of dry matter consumption, selective ranking raises recall by 39.70/28.18/20.50 percentage points, respectively. Furthermore, rolling evaluations over Yosemite show that the gains from ranking persist under temporal distribution shift. Together, these results show that PyroAdapt prioritizes the most fire-prone locations under a daily budget constraint and detects more extreme fire events.

ru.title: Адаптация моделей через ранжирование риска для предсказания лесных пожаров
ru.desc: В статье предложена система PyroAdapt для предсказания возникновения лесных пожаров, которая решает проблему редких событий и распределительного сдвига во времени. Метод использует pretrain-retrieve-rank подход: предварительно обученная модель адаптируется к целевым условиям путём поиска исторических локаций с похожими характеристиками и fine-tuning через ранжирование риска. Авторы применяют различные объективные функции, включая селективное ранжирование через единую формулировку score-gap, что повышает среднюю точность предсказания на 24.35-24.57% и recall в топ-5% до 22.11-22.79%. Экспериментальная оценка показывает, что система эффективна под бюджетным ограничением на количество ежедневных предсказаний и лучше детектирует экстремальные пожары даже при временном распределительном сдвиге.

en.title: Adapting Wildfire Predictions with PyroAdapt
en.desc: This paper addresses the challenge of predicting wildfires, which are rare events that vary in occurrence based on location and time. The authors introduce PyroAdapt, a framework that adapts a pretrained model to new conditions by retrieving similar historical data and fine-tuning the model based on risk ranking. The approach incorporates spatial factors like terrain and ecoregion to improve prediction accuracy. Results show that PyroAdapt significantly enhances the model's ability to identify high-risk areas for wildfires, even under changing conditions.

zh.title: PyroAdapt：提升火灾预测的智能框架
zh.desc: 本论文提出了一种名为PyroAdapt的框架，用于适应火灾预测模型以应对稀有事件问题。该框架通过检索历史相似条件的地点，并在这些地点上进行微调，从而提高模型在新条件下的表现。我们考虑了地形、生态区嵌入和火灾发生率等空间上下文因素，以优化风险排序。实验结果表明，PyroAdapt在加利福尼亚州的火灾预测中显著提高了模型的精确度和召回率，尤其是在极端火灾事件的检测上。

papers.title: Rolling-WAM: World Action Models with Rolling Imagination
papers.abstract: Abstract  World Action Models (WAMs) couple action generation with future visual prediction for robotic manipulation. However, completing the joint video-action denoising process at each replanning cycle incurs substantial latency, delaying action updates and limiting closed-loop responsiveness. We present Rolling-WAM, a formulation that distributes joint denoising across successive replanning cycles. Our method maintains a sliding window of video-action chunks at staggered noise levels. At each step, a rolling noise schedule fully denoises the imminent action chunk for execution, while partially refining farther-future chunks. As the window advances with new camera observations, the retained future chunks continue their denoising process. This distributes the computational cost over time while carrying an evolving visual-action context across chunk boundaries. Evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world Unitree G1 humanoid show that Rolling-WAM achieves competitive manipulation performance. By removing the need to denoise the entire prediction horizon from scratch, it delivers a 4.5x steady-state replanning speedup over standard joint WAMs.

ru.title: Распределённое денойзирование для быстрого и отзывчивого управления роботами
ru.desc: В статье предлагается Rolling-WAM — улучшенная версия World Action Models для робототехники, которая решает проблему высокой латентности при совместном денойзировании видео и действий. Вместо полного переобучения модели на каждом цикле переплана, метод распределяет процесс денойзирования видео-действия во времени, поддерживая скользящее окно блоков на разных уровнях шума. На каждом шаге полностью денойзируется только блок действия для немедленного исполнения, а будущие блоки частично уточняются, продолжая улучшаться по мере поступления новых наблюдений от камеры. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что предложенный подход достигает конкурентной производительности манипуляции и обеспечивает ускорение переплана в 4.5 раза.

en.title: Speeding Up Robotic Actions with Rolling-WAM
en.desc: The paper introduces Rolling-WAM, a new approach to improve the efficiency of World Action Models (WAMs) in robotic manipulation. It addresses the issue of latency caused by the need to denoise video-action pairs at each replanning cycle. By distributing the denoising process across multiple cycles, Rolling-WAM allows for faster action updates and better responsiveness. The method uses a sliding window of video-action chunks, enabling partial denoising of future actions while executing the current one, resulting in a significant speedup in replanning times.

zh.title: 提升机器人操作效率的Rolling-WAM
zh.desc: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将动作生成与未来视觉预测结合，用于机器人操作。然而，在每个重新规划周期中完成联合视频-动作去噪过程会导致显著的延迟，影响动作更新和闭环响应能力。我们提出了Rolling-WAM，这种方法在连续的重新规划周期中分配联合去噪的任务。通过保持一个滑动窗口，Rolling-WAM能够在执行即将到来的动作时完全去噪，同时逐步优化更远的未来动作，从而提高了操作效率。
